jobs.title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über DrAnsay

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.

Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.

Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.

Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.

Was du konkret machst

  • Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

  • OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

  • Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

  • Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

  • User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

  • Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

  • Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

  • Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren


Das brauchst du

  • Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

  • Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

  • Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

  • Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

Das fällt positiv auf

  • Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

  • Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

  • Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

  • Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

  • Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

  • Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

  • Erfahrung in stark regulierten Produktumfeldern

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX-Teams und der Einbindung von User Research

Was wir bieten

  • Vollzeit und unbefristet, Start ab November 2026

  • 100% Remote: Du arbeitest aus Deutschland, Vollzeit, ohne Standortbindung

  • Eine Rolle, die mitwächst: Je tiefer dein Verständnis von Produkten, Markt und Team, desto mehr Entscheidungen übernimmst du

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CPO und Zeit, alle Produktbereiche gründlich kennenzulernen

  • Sichtbare Wirkung: Du prägst, wie DrAnsay neue Produkte startet und woran das Product-Team arbeitet

  • Kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, Low-Ego-Kultur und direktem Feedback

  • Ein Produkt mit realem Nutzen: Wir helfen täglich Menschen, Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher zu bekommen

Wie du dich bewirbst

Bewirb dich direkt über das Bewerbungsformular. Kein Anschreiben erforderlich, wir stellen dir einige kurze Fragen, die uns helfen zu verstehen, wie du arbeitest. Diese Antworten sind uns wichtiger als dein LinkedIn-Profil.

Du hörst von uns innerhalb von fünf Arbeitstagen.

DrAnsay ist ein chancengleicher Arbeitgeber. Bewerbungen werden auf Basis von Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung bewertet. Alle Bewerbenden werden unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Religion oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen berücksichtigt. DrAnsay verarbeitet die mit deiner Bewerbung übermittelten personenbezogenen Daten zur Durchführung des Recruitingprozesses.

jobs.description:
Méthodes numériques et d’intelligence artificielle combinée à une approche expérimentale pour concevoir des matériaux et dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie à partir de composites biocarbone à base de graphite.

ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Le poste est à pourvoir au sein du Centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des SOlides Divisés, de l'Energie et de l'Environnement), unité mixte de recherche CNRS dédiée aux procédés, matériaux et énergies durables.

Le Postdoc sera dirigé par le professeur Ange Nzihou et codirigé par un chercheur de l'université de Princeton (États-Unis).

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

Ce travail s’inscrit dans un projet ERC (European Research Council) Advanced Grant. L’ERC est une organisation européenne de financement qui soutient des projets de recherche de rupture à travers des appels à projets très compétitifs, dans le cadre du programme Horizon Europe de l’Union européenne.

Le projet ERC vise à évaluer la capacité de stockage de composites innovants en biocarbones. Il s’agit d’une famille de matériaux carbonés avancés et durables issus de la biomasse, permettant de stocker l’énergie dans différents environnements, contrairement à la plupart des solutions actuelles reposant sur des matériaux d’origine fossile ou non durables. Cela devrait se traduire par une réduction notable des émissions de CO₂ et des économies d’énergie. Les travaux seront menés dans un environnement international, avec des visites régulières dans les laboratoires de partenaires en France, en Inde et aux États-Unis.

Nous recherchons un chercheur ou une chercheuse très motivé(e) pour contribuer à la conception et au développement de matériaux et de dispositifs de stockage de l’énergie avancés et performants, en combinant des méthodes de calcul, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et des approches expérimentales.

L’objectif est de développer et d’appliquer des modèles numériques, des méthodes fondées sur les données et des outils utilisant l’IA afin de prédire les propriétés des matériaux, d’optimiser leur composition et leur structure, et d’améliorer la capacité et les performances de stockage de l’énergie. Les travaux combineront des études théoriques et numériques avec la synthèse expérimentale, la caractérisation, la validation et l’optimisation de solutions innovantes de stockage de l’énergie.

Un axe important du projet portera sur l’étude des propriétés thermophysiques, thermomécaniques et de stabilité thermique de composites à base de biocarbone graphitique. Le/La candidat(e) étudiera les relations entre la structure des matériaux, leurs propriétés fonctionnelles, leur comportement et les performances globales du dispositif en conditions d’utilisation, afin de contribuer au développement de technologies de stockage de l’énergie sûres, efficaces et durables.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

• Solides compétences en sciences computationnelles, en méthodes apprentissage automatique (machine learning) et en méthodes fondées sur l’intelligence artificielle
• Solides compétences en caractérisation des matériaux, en recherche expérimentale et dans les technologies de stockage de l’énergie
• Bonnes compétences en programmation

Capacités et aptitudes :

• Rigueur scientifique, capacité d’analyse et de synthèse
• Autonomie et esprit d’initiative
• Capacité à travailler dans un environnement de recherche international et interdisciplinaire
• Bonne communication écrite et orale en anglais

 

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

Diplôme de doctorat (PhD) en génie des procédés, science des matériaux, génie énergétique, physique, sciences computationnelles ou dans un domaine connexe.

 

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :

  • 49 jours de congés par an

jobs.title: Offre de stage – Design et fabrication d’un circuit électronique flexible pour capteur de gaz portable – 5 à 6 mois
jobs.description:
English version


Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s'engager au sein d'une institution où la science et l'innovation construisent un avenir plus durable. C'est une école d'excellence où chacun a la possibilité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d'ingénieurs de France et reconnue à l'international, notre école, membre de l'Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en s'engageant activement face aux grands enjeux industriels, numériques et environnementaux. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 membres du personnel et 2 500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : allier excellence académique, recherche de pointe et impact sociétal positif.

L'Institut Mines-Télécom rassemble les plus grandes Écoles françaises pour relever les grands défis industriels, numériques, énergétiques et environnementaux. Avec ses huit Grandes Écoles publiques et ses deux Graduate Schools affiliées, il constitue le premier institut public dédié à la formation des ingénieurs et des managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable en formant les leaders qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Le département d'électronique flexible développe des connaissances technologiques et scientifiques dans le domaine de l'électronique souple. Le département dispose d'une solide expertise dans la caractérisation électrique et mécanique des matériaux et des interfaces. Ses activités sont regroupées au sein d'une plateforme de 660 m². Cette plateforme technologique rassemble des installations et des équipements technologiques dédiés aux activités de R&D en micropackaging, micro- et nano-électronique, au sein d'une salle blanche de 220 m² en classe 1000 et de 400 m² en classe 10 000.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que stagiaire, le/la candidat(e) réalisera des innovations et des activités de recherche dans le domaine de l’électronique. Au sein du département d’électronique flexible (FEL) du Centre de Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), le/la candidat(e) combinera passion des science et désir d’impact sociétal.

Ce stage fait partie du projet de recherche Sens-CO qui met en partenariat l’Université Gustave Eiffel, l’Ecole polytechnique et l’Ecole des mines de Saint-Etienne. Ce projet vise à développer un capteur de gaz NOx et COx portable pour un monitoring environnemental en continu. La résistance interne du capteur varie avec la concentration de gaz mesurée. Le rôle du CMP est d’obtenir précisément la valeur de cette résistance à travers un circuit électronique et de permettre la corrélation avec la concentration en gaz ainsi que le traitement et l’envoi des données par communication sans contact. Ce circuit doit permettre une mesure portable et nécessite donc d’être réalisé sur un substrat flexible.

Le/la candidat(e) devra ainsi, à partir d’un design réalisé sur PCB rigide, transposer cette interface de capteur de gaz sur un substrat souple en tenant compte des enjeux liés à ces méthodes. Compte tenu de la grande valeur des résistances à mesurer, le PCB final devra permettre :

·         Une mesure précise de grandes valeurs de résistance

·         Un faible-bruit et résistance aux interférences électromagnétiques, en tenant compte de l’agencement des composants pour permettre de garantir une flexibilité maximale.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons :

Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage :

Les dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables constituent une approche prometteuse pour le développement de systèmes électroniques temporaires, notamment dans le domaine biomédical. Ces dispositifs sont conçus pour assurer une fonction spécifique avant de se dégrader progressivement, ce qui nécessite le développement de matériaux adaptés et de solutions de stockage de l’énergie compatibles avec cette approche.

Dans ce contexte, ce stage porte sur le développement de matériaux d’électrode pour des batteries destinées aux dispositifs électroniques biorésorbables (resorbtronics). L’objectif est de préparer et de mettre en œuvre des matériaux d’électrode, puis d’étudier leurs propriétés électrochimiques afin de mieux comprendre leur comportement et d’évaluer leur potentiel pour le stockage de l’énergie.

Le/la stagiaire participera à la préparation des matériaux, à la réalisation des expériences électrochimiques ainsi qu’à l’analyse et à l’interprétation des résultats. Ce travail contribuera à identifier les paramètres influençant les performances des électrodes et à orienter leur optimisation.

  • Analyser et interpréter les résultats expérimentaux, puis contribuer à l’optimisation des protocoles de préparation et de caractérisation.

jobs.title: CDI - HR Data & Social Controlling Analyst H/F
jobs.description:
Mission principale

Rattachée à la Head of HR Operations, le/la HR Data & Social Controlling Analyst assure le pilotage de la masse salariale et des effectifs, tout en développant une approche analytique et data-driven de la fonction RH.

Il/elle garantit la fiabilité des données sociales, contribue à la construction et au suivi du budget RH, automatise les reportings et transforme les données RH en analyses pertinentes en étroite collaboration avec la Direction Financière.

Principales responsabilités

A. Contrôle de gestion sociale et pilotage de la masse salariale

  • Construire le budget annuel de masse salariale et des effectifs, en lien avec la DRH, la Direction Financière et les équipes opérationnelles.

  • Élaborer les prévisions actualisées (forecasts) et les projections de fin d'année.

  • Analyser les écarts entre réalisé, budget et prévisions, et identifier les principaux facteurs explicatifs.

  • Modéliser les effets des évolutions d'effectifs, des augmentations salariales, des promotions, des bonus, des départs et des recrutements.

  • Réaliser des simulations financières pour accompagner les décisions RH : recrutements, réorganisations, politiques de rémunération et évolution des effectifs.

  • Suivre les principaux indicateurs économiques et sociaux : masse salariale, effectifs, rémunération moyenne, coûts des recrutements et autres coûts RH.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration des processus de contrôle et de fiabilisation des données de paie et de rémunération.

  • Préparer les analyses nécessaires aux revues budgétaires et aux présentations destinées au CODIR.

B. HR Data Analytics et aide à la décision

  • Exploiter et croiser les données issues du SIRH, de la paie, du recrutement et des autres outils RH.

  • Analyser les tendances RH et identifier les principaux facteurs d'évolution des indicateurs sociaux.

  • Réaliser des analyses approfondies sur le turnover, l'absentéisme, le recrutement, la mobilité interne, les rémunérations et les parcours professionnels.

  • Identifier les populations, métiers ou entités nécessitant une attention particulière et formuler des recommandations opérationnelles.

  • Développer des analyses permettant d'évaluer l'efficacité des politiques RH et d'en mesurer les résultats.

  • Concevoir des analyses prospectives et, lorsque les données le permettent, des modèles de prévision pour anticiper les évolutions des effectifs et des indicateurs sociaux.

  • Traduire les résultats des analyses en recommandations compréhensibles et directement exploitables par les équipes RH et les managers.

C. Reporting, Business Intelligence et automatisation

  • Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer les tableaux de bord RH et les reportings destinés à la DRH, au CODIR et aux équipes opérationnelles.

  • Automatiser la production des reportings récurrents afin de réduire les tâches manuelles et de sécuriser les résultats.

  • Développer des dashboards interactifs permettant de suivre les indicateurs clés et d'analyser les données par métier, entité, pays, population ou niveau hiérarchique.

  • Harmoniser les définitions, les règles de calcul et les référentiels des indicateurs RH.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité, de la cohérence et de la disponibilité des données sociales.

  • Participer à l'évolution des outils de reporting et à l'optimisation des processus de collecte et d'exploitation des données.

D. Projets RH

  • Participer activement à l’ensemble des exercices annuels liés aux sujets Comp & Ben :

  • Révision annuelle des salaires, évaluation des bonus, plan de commissionnement pour les équipes de vente.

  • Etudes de rémunérations, benchmarks internes et externes.

Profil recherché

Formation

  • Bac +5 en contrôle de gestion, finance, statistiques, data analytics, ressources humaines ou école de commerce avec spécialisation pertinente.

  • Une double compétence en finance et en data constitue un atout.

Expérience

  • 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en contrôle de gestion sociale, HR Analytics, contrôle de gestion ou analyse de données, idéalement avec une exposition aux problématiques RH.

  • Une expérience dans le retail, la mode, le luxe ou un environnement multi-entités est appréciée.

Compétences techniques

  • Excellente maîtrise d'Excel et des fonctions avancées d'analyse de données.

  • Bonne maîtrise de Power BI.

  • Capacité à manipuler, consolider et analyser des données provenant de plusieurs systèmes.

  • Bonne compréhension des mécanismes de masse salariale, des rémunérations, des effectifs et des principaux indicateurs sociaux.

  • Capacité à construire des modèles budgétaires, des prévisions et des analyses de sensibilité.

  • La connaissance du système de paie ADP est un avantage.

  • Doté d’un esprit analytique, vous êtes rigoureux et proactif, vous comprenez l’environnement Business, et êtes à l’aise dans la collaboration avec les différents départements.

Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force. Nous étudions toutes les candidatures avec la même attention, sans distinction de genre, de handicap, d'origine, d'âge ou d'orientation.

jobs.title: Accountant till ESL Shipping

Du arbetar nära Chief Accountant och bidrar till en korrekt, stabil och effektiv redovisning.Rollen har operativ tyngdpunkt men också ett tydligt utvecklingsperspektiv. ESL Shipping vill fortsätta effektivisera sina redovisningsprocesser och dra nytta av automatisering, AI och nya digitala verktyg. Du behöver inte vara teknisk specialist, men ska vara nyfiken på hur arbetssätt kan förbättras och kunna omsätta idéer i praktiken.I dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter ingår att:genomföra kontoavstämningar och löpande bokningarhantera periodiseringar och avsättningaransvara för momshanteringta fram periodsammanställningar och bidra till rapporteringenarbeta med anläggningsredovisning, bland annat kopplat till bolagets fartyghantera intercompany-transaktionerbidra till effektiva redovisningsprocesserkommunicera med kollegor, kunder och leverantörer i Sverige och internationelltvid behov vara backup inom kund- och leverantörsreskontraDu rapporterar till Chief Accountant och ingår i en internationell ekonomifunktion med kollegor i Sverige och Finland. På sikt kan samarbetet mellan de svenska och finska verksamheterna fördjupas ytterligare.Lämplig bakgrundVi söker dig som har arbetat några år som redovisningsekonom eller i en liknande kvalificerad redovisningsroll. Du har en stabil grund inom redovisning och kan självständigt ta ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter.För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:löpande redovisning och kontoavstämningarperiodiseringar och avsättningarmoms och periodrapporteringanläggningsredovisningintercompany-redovisningbokslutsarbete och rapporteringDet är värdefullt om du har arbetat i en internationell miljö. Erfarenhet från ett noterat bolag eller verksamhet med rapportering enligt IFRS är meriterande, men du behöver inte vara IFRS-specialist. Det viktigaste är att du har ett intresse för området och att det inte är helt nytt för dig.Har du haft helhetsansvar för redovisningen i ett mindre bolag, inklusive årsredovisning, ser vi det som en fördel. Detsamma gäller erfarenhet av att utveckla eller effektivisera ekonomiprocesser.Du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi eller redovisning. Då arbetet har många internationella kontaktytor behöver du kunna kommunicera tydligt på både svenska och engelska.Personliga egenskaperFör att trivas hos ESL Shipping behöver du uppskatta en verksamhet där det händer mycket och förutsättningarna ibland förändras snabbt. Du är strukturerad och noggrann, men samtidigt pragmatisk och lösningsorienterad.Du tar ansvar, vågar ta plats i relevanta frågor och ser vad som behöver göras, men gör det på ett ödmjukt sätt. Organisationen är relativt liten och det är därför viktigt att du är samarbetsorienterad och bidrar där det behövs.Vi tror också att du:har ett processtarkt och metodiskt arbetssättär nyfiken på automatisering, AI och digital utvecklingidentifierar förbättringsmöjligheter i det dagliga arbetetär öppen för nya system och arbetssättkommunicerar tryggt med interna och externa kontaktervill fortsätta utvecklas genom bredare ansvar och förbättrade arbetssättDet här är en roll för dig som söker ett långsiktigt uppdrag där du kan fördjupa din kompetens, påverka processer och successivt bredda ditt ansvar. Utvecklingen ligger framför allt i rollen och möjligheten att bidra till ekonomifunktionens fortsatta utveckling.Vad erbjuder viHos ESL Shipping får du möjlighet att:- arbeta brett med kvalificerad redovisning i en internationell miljö- få en central roll i en liten och samarbetsorienterad ekonomifunktion- arbeta nära Chief Accountant och successivt få större eget ansvar- påverka redovisningsprocesser och bidra till automatiserade och AI-stödda arbetssätt- bli en del av en verksamhet som står inför en intressant förändringsresaOm företagetESL Shipping är ett internationellt rederi med finskt ursprung. Bolaget verkar i en snabbrörlig bransch med internationella kontaktytor och nära samarbete mellan funktioner och länder.Den svenska verksamheten finns för närvarande i Ystad och flyttar till ett nytt kontor i Malmö i januari. Som Accountant blir du en del av en internationell organisation med ekonomikollegor i Sverige och Finland.AnsökanI denna rekrytering samarbetar ESL Shipping med SJR. jobs.title: Mid Market Account Executive - Benelux
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is a leader in a dynamic market. As a public company listed on the NYSE with $2.1B in ARR, we deliver mission-critical solutions to physical operations globally. This position is tailored for high-performing professionals seeking to accelerate their professional growth. We are seeking account managers to oversee deal sizes ranging from €10k to €300k across a comprehensive suite of 15+ product solutions, engaging key decision-makers including Finance Directors and Managing Directors. Joining our team offers the autonomy and support to tackle challenging objectives and drive impactful results.

While this position offers remote flexibility across the Netherlands, periodic travel to meet clients on-site is expected (typically bi-weekly).

You should apply if:

  • You want to help define the future of physical operations: Your contributions will directly enable real-world impact—supporting critical infrastructure, streamlining supply chains, and advancing workforce safety.
  • You prioritize continuous prospecting: Physical operations encompass wide-ranging sectors where contacts are often mobile. Top sales reps actively identify prospective organizations and build meaningful pipeline connection points.
  • You possess deep curiosity about diverse business models: You will explore various physical sectors, from field services to manufacturing and food distribution, striving to understand operational details at scale.
  • You are committed to continuous learning: Navigating our cloud platform involves mastering new operational domains and solutions, requiring dedicated focus to achieve long-term growth.
  • You foster authentic long-term partnerships: Many target organizations are transitioning from legacy methods to modern cloud technology. Earning long-term trust is core to helping them digitally transform.
  • You thrive on high-performing teams: Working at Samsara means being part of a team dedicated to excellence and pushing boundaries as we build for the future.

In this role you will:

  • Drive revenue acquisition: Take ownership of net-new customer growth by generating 80-90% of your opportunity pipeline through outbound efforts.
  • Expand key regional markets: Contribute to the growth of our mid-market segment across the Benelux region, leveraging expanding regional momentum.
  • Leverage structured methodologies: Utilize professional sales frameworks such as MEDDPICC and Command the Message to effectively guide customer engagements.

jobs.title: Clinical Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European- and US-based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia's ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

The Role

As our Clinical Solutions Consultant, you'll be the bridge between science, technology, and sales, helping biotech and pharma companies understand how Rivia can transform the way they work with clinical trial data.

You'll partner closely with our Account Executives throughout the technical stages of the sales cycle, turning complex scientific and technical challenges into compelling product demonstrations, tailored sandboxes, and solutions that address real customer needs.

This isn't a role where you simply present slides or follow a demo script. You'll need to understand clinical trial workflows, get hands-on with data, challenge assumptions, and translate complex customer requirements into solutions we can actually deliver.

You'll also play an important role in shaping how we approach technical pre-sales at Rivia, building repeatable processes, improving our demo environments, and helping us scale without losing the scientific depth and customer understanding that make us different.

What Excites You

  • Bringing science and technology together: You love understanding complex scientific challenges and translating them into practical, impactful solutions.

  • Being hands-on: You don't just talk about what a product can do. You enjoy building demos, configuring sandboxes, working with data, and showing customers what's possible.

  • Making an impact on revenue: You enjoy being part of the sales process, influencing strategic deals, and helping customers confidently make decisions.

  • Solving real customer problems: You're curious about how biotech and pharma companies operate and enjoy finding creative ways to address their challenges.

  • Building from the ground up: You get excited about joining a growing company where you can shape processes, improve tools, and help establish how technical pre-sales should work.

  • Working across teams: You enjoy collaborating with Sales, Product, and Engineering, balancing commercial opportunities with technical feasibility.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account Executives as the scientific and technical expert throughout the sales process, helping prospects understand how Rivia can address their specific challenges.

  • Lead in-depth product demonstrations tailored to customers' clinical trial workflows, data structures, and scientific requirements.

  • Build and configure customized sandboxes, demo environments, and prototype integrations to demonstrate Rivia's value using realistic customer scenarios.

  • Understand customers' clinical trial pipelines, protocols, endpoints, and data challenges, translating their needs into practical technical solutions.

  • Scope prospective customer implementations, identifying technical requirements, dependencies, risks, and feasibility before commercial commitments are made.

  • Collaborate closely with Solutions Engineers and Customer Engagement to ensure smooth handovers from pre-sales to implementation.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to both customers and internal teams, confidently addressing complex scientific questions while being transparent about product capabilities and limitations.

  • Adapt demonstrations and technical conversations to customers' familiarity with and readiness to adopt AI-driven solutions.

  • Identify recurring customer needs, technical objections, and product gaps, sharing insights with Product and Engineering to continuously improve our offering.

  • Help develop scalable pre-sales processes, reusable demo environments, and technical documentation as Rivia grows.

What Excites Us

  • Scientific background: You have a degree in life sciences, bioinformatics, biomedical engineering, or a related scientific discipline, and you're comfortable navigating complex scientific discussions.

  • Relevant experience: You bring at least 4 years of client-facing experience in solutions consulting, technical pre-sales, field application science, technical account management, or similar roles.

  • Scientific and technical fluency: You understand scientific data and experimental logic, and can quickly grasp complex clinical trial workflows and technical requirements.

  • Hands-on technical skills: You've personally built and configured product demos, sandboxes, or technical proof-of-concepts, rather than only presenting solutions developed by others.

  • Commercial mindset: You understand how technical expertise contributes to winning deals and enjoy working closely with sales teams to move opportunities forward.

  • Customer-facing confidence: You can communicate complex technical concepts clearly and credibly, whether you're speaking with scientists, clinical operations leaders, or technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ownership: You're proactive, independent, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where processes are still being built.

  • Collaborative approach: You know when to challenge assumptions, push back on unrealistic commitments, and work across teams to deliver the best outcomes for customers.

Bonus / Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in scientific software, clinical trial technology, biotech platforms, or laboratory informatics.

  • Familiarity with clinical trial protocols, endpoints, regulatory considerations, and clinical data integration.

  • Experience working with AI-driven products or communicating the value of AI to scientific and technical stakeholders.

Our Values

  • In It to Win It: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive to achieve the best possible outcomes.

  • Embrace Change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead.

  • Why Not?: We challenge assumptions, stay curious, and explore new possibilities rather than accepting things as they are.

  • Find the Gap: We proactively identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and solve problems before they arise.

  • Collective Accountability: We're one team, on one mission, committed to shared responsibility, mutual support, and trust.

  • Value Add Solutions: Know better. Act better. We're dedicated to delivering meaningful solutions that create real impact.

jobs.title: Audit Methodology Lead
jobs.description:
We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar.

You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. jobs.description:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Mission of this role

Thousands of rental companies run their business on Rentman, and many of them depend on it talking smoothly to the rest of their stack: accounting packages, webshops, calendars, and our public API. When an integration breaks, invoices don’t sync, bookings go missing, and customers notice fast.

As Senior QA Specialist for the Integrations team, you make sure every release reaches those customers without regressions. You own the team’s test strategy and lead the move from manual release-day testing to an automated, shift-left suite. This is a role with real ownership: you shape how the team thinks about quality, and you grow the practice as our integrations platform grows.

  • Coach developers so they own their tests, and organise QA days with the other product teams

  • At least 2 years writing and maintaining test automation in code (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, ideally TypeScript/JavaScript), not only record-and-play tools

Nice to haves

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

This Account Executive role at Prelude is a hunting position, built for an outbound-first seller who thrives on prospecting and knows how to move fast. You’ll close SMB deals at volume across multiple industries and own the full cycle from A to Z, including your own prospecting, demos, and negotiation. Because you’ll handle technical stakeholders directly, you’ll also become a true expert in our product.

What will you be doing?

  • Running your own outbound motion through cold calls, emails and LinkedIn to build pipeline from the ground up, working closely with our high-performing BDRs

  • Owning the full sales cycle from first call to closed-won, typically within a short sales cycle

  • Qualifying SMB prospects across multiple industries

  • Running discovery that uncovers real pain and moves deals forward

  • Delivering demos tailored to each buyer, including technical stakeholders

  • Hitting and exceeding monthly and quarterly targets for pipeline generation, activities and closed revenue

  • Keeping HubSpot up to date for accurate forecasting

What are we looking for?

  • At least 2 to 3 years in a closing role running a full outbound sales cycle with a track record of closing high-volume SMB deals

  • A strong outbound background, ideally as a BDR or SDR - you’re comfortable picking up the phone 50+ times a day and know how to hook a prospect in the first 30 seconds

  • SaaS sales experience is a must - you know what an API is and can hold your own in a conversation with a technical buyer

  • Consistent quota attainment and overachievement

  • A hunter mindset and the ownership to build your own pipeline and drive your own metrics

  • Sharp, instinctive discovery skills - you can uncover pain efficiently

  • Curiosity and the drive to become a product expert, so every conversation is relevant and consultative

  • Fluency in English

  • Familiarity with HubSpot is a nice to have

  • Genuine excitement for what Prelude is building

What do we offer?

  • Competitive base salary with uncapped commission + BSPCEs

  • Hybrid working style: 4 days in-office in Paris, 1 day remote

  • High-end gear and ergonomic setup

  • 100% travel subsidised to our Paris office

  • Private health insurance

  • Swile meal vouchers

  • Gym pass

  • Annual offsites in great locations

  • The opportunity to be part of building something big, from the start!

Interview process

  • Meet a member of the Talent team

  • Interview with Hiring Manager

  • Role-play session with Sales

  • Final meeting with the CEO

We care about your potential and motivation. If you're excited about the role and this sounds like your next step, we’d love to hear from you

jobs.title: Freelance Talent Sourcer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France: an AI agent runs the entire sale and purchase journey end-to-end, orchestrating local brokers, portals, buyers, and documents.

Backed by €60 million from top-tier investors Sequoia Capital and Kima Ventures, we're committed to accelerating life changes for millions of current and future European homeowners.

The Mission

  • Start: as soon as possible

  • Duration: 1 month, renewable

  • Location: on-site, Le Peletier office, Paris 9th, 5 days a week

  • Status: freelance

  • Pay: around €5,000 excl. VAT per month at target (daily rate of €175 excl. VAT + monthly variable: €50 per sourced candidate reaching the final interview, €500 per sourced hire)

 

Your Mission

Zefir is hiring across Sales, Engineering, Product and Ops, and the Talent team is the engine behind it. We are looking for a freelance SDR to join the team, learn sourcing from our Founding Talent Lead, and run our AI recruiting workflows every day.

Think outbound prospecting, except your leads are candidates.

 

What You'll Do

Build and improve our AI recruiting workflows | About 30% of your time

Help shape how Zefir uses AI to find, assess and engage talent. Work with our Talent Lead to turn ideas into working automations, test them on real recruiting needs, and improve them through daily use.

  • Build and experiment. Create and adapt workflows for candidate sourcing, scoring, outreach and recruiting dashboards.

  • Test, learn, iterate. Try different prompts and approaches, review the results, and refine what works.

  • Bring your recruiting judgment. Check AI recommendations against real candidate profiles and use what you learn to improve the next batch.

  • Make the system better every day. Debug issues, remove repetitive steps, and spot opportunities to automate more of the groundwork.

Source candidates for our open roles | About 70% of your time

  • Source profiles for open roles from the scorecard and the hiring manager brief.

  • Expand the pool: past Ashby candidates, LinkedIn Recruiter, target companies.

  • Add qualified leads to Ashby with a one-line rationale and prepare outreach drafts in Zefir's voice.

 

What You Bring

  • A junior profile with a sharp, structured mind: you learn fast.

  • A strong general education. No hard skills required.

  • A first experience as an SDR or BDR (ideally in a B2B startup) is a plus. We are not looking for a cold-calling specialist, but for someone who can run written outbound at volume: LinkedIn and email sequences, follow-ups, a clean CRM.

  • No recruiting experience needed: our Talent Lead trains you on sourcing during your first weeks.

  • You are comfortable with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Zapier, n8n…).

  • You are rigorous with data, and you look for the cause of an error before escalating.

  • Strong writing in French, working English.

  • Freelance status, or ready to set one up.

 

Process

  1. 20-minute call with David (Talent Lead)

  2. Practical case on site: live role-play on sourcing and outreach (nothing to prepare beforehand)


Benefits

The following is for permanent employees only. For other contracts (interns, apprentices, fixed-term..), please, check with your recruiter.

  • Competitive salary: You can run your own simulation with our salary calculator.

  • BSPCE (Stock Options): Available for everyone, with monthly vesting after year one, over a 4-year period.

  • Healthcare plan: Full coverage with Alan for team members, their partners, and children.

  • Office in Le Peletier, Paris (9th arrondissement): With flexible remote work options.

  • Swile meal card: €11 per worked day.

  • Swile mobility card: €45/month to support sustainable transportation (metro, carpooling, biking…).

  • Team events: Monthly Mixers to connect and share good times, and quarterly All Hands to celebrate wins across the company.

Our Operating Principles

🏔️ Steep Mountains Are Steep: Setting ambitious goals and working hard to achieve them.

🌊 Ride Reality: Actively seeking challenges and thriving by adapting flexibly to changes.

🏀 Play for the Front of the Jersey: Prioritizing team success over individual recognition.

Application & Process

We welcome applications from anyone, regardless of background, gender, sexual orientation, religion, age, or experience. Our team values authenticity and diverse perspectives.

For all roles, our interview process emphasizes hands-on exercises, case studies, or discussions about specific examples of your previous work. We ensure objectives and expectations are clearly communicated at every step.

jobs.title: Brand Director
jobs.description:
We're a group of friends building apps for friends, and we think friendship deserves a better place online. Our brand is how the world first meets that idea, usually in a three-second scroll, in a language that isn't ours, on a phone in a city we've never been to.


We're looking for a Brand Lead who writes like a dream and ships like a machine. Someone who's run global campaigns at a top agency, knows what a great brief feels like, and is ready to trade the client side of the table for owning the whole thing.


You'll shape how amo sounds, looks and shows up everywhere, from a two-word push notification to a launch film watched in fifteen countries.

What you'll do:

  • Own the amo voice. Write it, guard it, and make it better every week. App copy, launch posts, store listings, social, scripts, the little lines that make people smile.

  • Run global campaigns end to end. From the first idea on a napkin to the last cut in market, across Europe, the US and beyond.

  • Brief and push creative partners. Agencies, directors, creators and our in-house design team. You know how to get their best work because you've been on their side of the table.

  • Make the brand local without making it boring. Adapt ideas so they land in Paris, London, LA and Seoul, not just translate them.

  • Measure what the brand is really doing. Set up and run brand tracking across our markets, following awareness, consideration and perception over time, and turn what you learn into the next brief.

  • Work in days, not weeks. Spot a moment on Tuesday, have a campaign live on Thursday, learn from it on Friday.

  • Sweat the details. Easter eggs, onboarding screens, the name of a feature. Small words do big work here.

What that may look like:

Kicking off a campaign with an agency for our next market launch, and setting up the tracker that tells us a month later whether people there know who we are and like what they see.

Who you are:

  • A writer first. You can make a headline sing and kill your darlings without blinking. Your portfolio proves it.

  • Agency-trained. You've spent real time at a creative agency and worked on brands people actually know. You've sat in the pitch, survived the feedback round and shipped anyway.

  • Global from day one. You've led or played a key role in campaigns that ran across several markets at once, and you know what changes (and what never should) from one country to the next.

  • Fast and opinionated. Conviction over consensus. You'd rather put out something great today than something perfect next month.

  • Fluent in internet. You know what's trending before it trends, and you can tell the difference between a moment worth joining and one worth skipping.

  • Bilingual or better is a plus. English is our working language. French, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean or Japanese would make us very happy.

Bonus points if:

You've worked on a consumer app, built a brand from scratch, or have a group chat that's funnier than most ad campaigns.

Why amo:

  • You'll own it. No account director, no client sign-off chain. Your ideas go from your head to millions of phones.

  • You'll move fast. We make decisions quickly and learn from mistakes even quicker. Intense, but healthy.

  • You'll be in good company. Over half the team is international, with 25 nationalities and counting. One in four of us moved cities or countries to be here.

  • You'll grow x10. Colleagues across product, design, engineering and growth will challenge your work every day, and you'll do the same to theirs.

  • You'll have backing. We're supported by some of the best tier-1 investors in the world and growing at a pace our space hasn't seen in years.

Life at amo:

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week. We wanted to make sure coming to the office is as comfortable as possible for you:

  • We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A).

  • We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

  • We reimburse your commuting expenses 50%.

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎).

    • 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state);

    • 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

    • ~11 bank holidays.

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in the summer and one week in the winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). This enables everyone to actually disconnect and enjoy their vacation. No Slack, no email, no FOMO. Per French standard, we also offer another 4 weeks to allow team members to choose when they want to take time off.

How to apply:

Send us your CV and a portfolio, plus one thing you'd rewrite on our website or in our app, and why. Keep it short. We'll know.

jobs.title: Polymechaniker & Techniker
jobs.description:
About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In dieser Rolle

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Hardware-Team zusammen und sorgst für eine qualitativ hochwertige, reproduzierbare Produktion unserer Aktuatoren und Robotersysteme. Mit deinem Feedback trägst du dazu bei, Hardware und Prozesse laufend zu verbessern.

  • Mechanische Montage, Fertigung & Build-Umsetzung: Du bist verantwortlich für den mechanischen Aufbau, die Montage und die Fertigungsschritte unserer Robotersysteme.

  • Fertigungs- & Prototyping-Support: Du stellst mit Fertigungsmaschinen und 3D-Druckern kundenspezifische Teile her (Vorrichtungen, Lehren und Produktionsteile) und bringst Vorschläge ein, wie sich der Prozess verbessern und vereinfachen lässt.

  • Prozessbegleitende Qualitätskontrolle: Du führst systematische Qualitätskontrollen anhand unserer Qualitätskennzahlen durch und dokumentierst die Ergebnisse, damit die Produktion rückverfolgbar bleibt.

  • Maschinenverfügbarkeit & Wartung: Du verantwortest den Unterhalt unserer zentralen Maschinen und übernimmst regelmässige Wartung, Kalibrierung und Fehlerbehebung.

  • Du hilfst mit, die Werkstatt selbst weiterzuentwickeln: Layout, Werkzeuge und Abläufe verbessern, während wir wachsen.

Was wir suchen

  • Technische Fähigkeiten: Praktische Erfahrung in der mechanischen Montage, sicherer Umgang mit Werkstattwerkzeugen (Messschieber, Lötkolben, Bohrmaschinen), 3D-Druck und grundlegende Maschinenbedienung.

  • Technischer Hintergrund: Eine einschlägige Berufsausbildung (z. B. Polymechaniker/in, Automatiker/in, Elektroniker/in EFZ oder eine vergleichbare Lehre) oder gleichwertige praktische Berufserfahrung in mechanischer Montage, Mechatronik oder elektrischen Systemen.

  • Problemlösung: Du kannst Hardwareprobleme selbstständig analysieren und beheben und hinterfragst deine eigene Arbeit kritisch, um Verbesserungen zu finden.

  • Du liest technische Zeichnungen sicher und arbeitest selbstständig nach schriftlichen Anleitungen.

  • Sorgfalt: Du schätzt einen aufgeräumten, funktionalen Arbeitsplatz und gehst technische Aufgaben systematisch an.

  • Fliessend Englisch oder Deutsch, mit mindestens Grundkenntnissen in Englisch (A2/B1) und der Bereitschaft, dazuzulernen (wir sind ein internationales Team).

Pluspunkte, wenn du

  • Erfahrung im Formenbau, im Vergiessen/Verkapseln oder in der Elektromotorenproduktion hast

  • gerne tüftelst und in deiner Freizeit eigene Roboter, RC-Flugzeuge, 3D-Drucker oder Ähnliches gebaut hast. Schick uns Fotos oder ein Portfolio!

  • Erfahrung mit CAD-Zeichnungen und Prototyping hast

  • Erfahrung mit schweren Werkstattmaschinen wie Drehbank, Fräse, CNC usw. mitbringst

Was wir bieten

  • Die Möglichkeit, an einigen der grössten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit zu arbeiten und echten Impact zu erzielen

  • Ein dynamisches Lernumfeld mit einem herausragenden, motivierten Team

  • Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an: In einem Startup in der Frühphase setzt du Ideen schnell um und siehst die Wirkung deiner Arbeit direkt

  • Visa-Sponsoring und Umzugsunterstützung, damit wir die Besten der Welt gewinnen können

  • Ein erstklassiges Arbeitsumfeld vor Ort im Zentrum von Zürich, mit hervorragender Prototyping-, Robotik- und technischer Infrastruktur für alle, die gerne mit den Händen arbeiten

jobs.title: Senior People Business Partner
jobs.description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Senior People Business Partner

As a Senior People Business Partner at myTomorrows, you are a trusted advisor to senior leaders and the Leadership Team. This is our most senior individual contributor People Business Partner role, where you translate business priorities into practical people solutions that enable high performing teams and organizational growth.

You partner closely with leaders across the organization to strengthen leadership effectiveness, organizational design, performance, engagement, and talent development. You enjoy balancing strategic thinking with hands on execution and are comfortable navigating the pace, ambiguity, and opportunities of a fast growing international scale up.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates who live within commuting distance of our Amsterdam office.

What you'll do in this role:

  • Partner with senior leaders and Leadership Team members on organizational design, workforce planning, team effectiveness, and organizational health.

  • Coach leaders on performance management, leadership effectiveness, feedback, development, and difficult people conversations.

  • Lead complex employee relations cases, including performance improvement, conflict resolution, absence management, and sensitive exits.

  • Drive and continuously improve key People programs, including performance management, engagement, talent reviews, succession planning, and career development.

  • Translate business strategy into practical People initiatives that support organizational growth and scalability.

  • Use people data and insights to identify trends, challenge assumptions, and recommend actions that improve engagement, retention, and organizational performance.

  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition and People Operations to deliver an outstanding employee experience across the entire employee lifecycle.

  • Ensure consistent application of People policies, employment legislation, and People practices across your business areas.

  • Lead cross functional People projects that improve organizational effectiveness, manager capability, and operational excellence.

  • Act as a trusted sparring partner who balances strategic thinking with hands on execution.

What you bring to the table:

  • At least 6 years of experience as an HR Business Partner or People Business Partner in a fast growing international organization.

  • Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders on organizational and people topics.

  • Extensive experience managing complex employee relations, performance management, and organizational change.

  • Strong coaching, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Solid knowledge of Dutch employment law and HR best practices.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate people data into actionable business insights.

  • Comfortable operating independently, making sound judgments, and managing competing priorities.

  • Experience working in a technology, SaaS, HealthTech, or scale up environment is highly preferred.

  • Experience with modern HR systems such as Personio is a plus.

  • Experience supporting international teams is a plus.

What we offer:

  • Serve a purposeful mission by helping patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments.

  • International work environment with scale up energy and a flat organization.

jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Maria, Interim VP Product at FeedbackFruits. 👋

FeedbackFruits is moving from a founder-led company to a product-led one, which means Product is taking on a much bigger role in deciding what we build and why. Before stepping into this role I worked as a PM here myself, with the squads and within the details, so I know how much depends on the PMs who work with those squads every day. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Ruby on Rails
jobs.description:
We're hiring a full-stack engineer to help us build the next version of FeedbackFruits.

  • We believe in engineers who stay close to the product: domain experts who pay attention to how users actually behave and use the platform.

  • Most of the work comes down to one thing: making the product better. We rethink each feature from the user's perspective and rebuild it on stronger foundations, together with our designers and product managers.

  • We modernise the stack as we go, moving from Rails + Ember.js to Rails + Hotwire. There's deeper technical work alongside it, on performance, stability, and the platform, all in service of a product that feels faster and more reliable.

  • Stabilisation and simplification are our top concerns, from both a product and an engineering standpoint. We'd rather fix root causes for the long term than patch symptoms, even when patching would be quicker.

  • Our long-term aim is to get closer to our users by shipping faster, moving from one monthly release with regular hotfixes toward continuous delivery.

  • We've also adopted agentic coding and integrations to sharpen how we work, and we value multipliers: engineers who raise the people around them and put the team before their own output.

What you'll do:

  • Join one of our engineering squads and own full-stack delivery on the roadmap, from backend logic and database design to the server-rendered UI it connects to

  • Lead the migration of Ember features to Rails + Hotwire, which means understanding the existing functionality, redesigning it thoughtfully together with PMs/designers, and shipping something better than what was there before

  • Handle support escalations and legacy bug-fixing as part of the mix alongside feature work. The balance will depend on which squad you join, but keeping the codebase healthy and customers unblocked is part of the job

  • Contribute to improving our CI/CD practices and deployment pipeline as we work toward more frequent, more reliable releases

  • Keep performance in mind across the stack

  • Build and maintain integrations with Learning Management Systems using LTI and partner APIs

  • Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions, bringing both quality standards and a pragmatist's sense of what's worth the effort

What you bring:

  • You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience and Ruby on Rails is your home stack: you've shipped production code with it, you know its conventions, and you're comfortable in its edges

  • You write tests as a matter of course, not as an afterthought. RSpec and Capybara are part of your regular toolkit, and you write tests that actually catch things rather than just confirm the happy path

  • You are user-oriented: when you're deciding how a feature should work, your first instinct is to think about the person using it, not the implementation that's most convenient

  • You've worked in a legacy codebase before and come through it well. You know what to fix, what to leave, and how to leave things better than you found them without getting stuck in a refactoring spiral

  • You understand CI/CD well enough to work within good practices and to nudge a codebase toward them when they're missing

  • You communicate clearly, give honest feedback in code reviews, and take it just as well. You’re collaborative without needing everyone to agree with you

  • You are pragmatic and document your decisions; you'd rather make a thoughtful trade-off and write it down than chase the perfect solution indefinitely

  • Familiarity with Ember.js or migration scenarios from it to Hotwire is a genuine advantage here; experience with AI dev tooling, Azure, or observability practices would serve you well too

What you get:

Our Finance team is ramping up over the next couple of years, and we are looking for someone to join the team on a 24-32 hour basis! Finance here runs across two entities, a Dutch BV and a US Corp, each with its own invoicing, tax and banking rules. Our customers are universities all over the world, so the work ranges from a straightforward Dutch invoice to a US procurement portal with its own supplier onboarding forms and submission rules. I'm looking for a Financial Administrator to take on our day-to-day operations: billing and collections on the receivables side, supplier invoices and payment runs on the payables side, and the Finance mailbox where everything is coordinated. We're a small team of two, and we support the wider organisation with a vast range of topics. You'd work closely with our New Business and Partner Success teams when it comes to billing, and with our Marketing team when it comes to purchasing. When an invoice goes out on time, a university pays on schedule or a purchasing inquiry is resolved ahead of an event, that's visible, and it will be thanks to you. What you'll do:

jobs.title: Graduate Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
Thanks for stopping by and learning more about this role at Sitemate! ✨🏗️

We’d love to hear from you 👩‍💻👩🏽‍💻🧑🏿‍💻👨🏻‍💻

📝 Overview

The Sales Development Representative is responsible for qualifying and routing inbound leads across two channels: self-service and inside sales. This role involves frequent engagement with prospects through phone calls, emails, live chat, and internal tools such as Slack and Salesforce. This role runs inside that same AI-native approach we build for customers. Leads and account data flow into an AI-populated Salesforce, so reps start from a clean, enriched pipeline instead of manual entry. Every call is coached live by ClaudeMate, giving real-time feedback on framing, objection handling, and next steps as the conversation happens. Success in the role is measured by the number of product demonstrations booked and completed, with a strong track record of team performance consistently meeting or exceeding monthly targets.

 

Room to grow, fast-tracked

We hire SDRs expecting you to grow past the role. “Grow from Within" is one of our leadership operating principles - meaning proven performance gets noticed and backed fast, and that managers and leaders are encouraged to gravitate towards internal promotions vs. external hires

For SDRs, that typically means a path to Account Executive within 9 to 12 months, based on performance, not tenure. One of our SDRs moved into a leadership role running Sales Development for all of North America within 8 months. Others have made the jump from SDR to Enterprise AE and describe the same pattern from the other side: "Sitemate is process-driven (everything engineered), so if you can learn and grow from these processes and you’re open to honest, constructive feedback while giving your best every day, you'll level up quickly".

Read more stories like these on People of Sitemate.

Employment:

  • Salary:

    • OTE Remuneration:

      • £49,500 (incl. Pension)

    • Base Salary:

      • £33,000

    • Commission:

      • £16,500

🔧 Day-to-Day

  • You will be qualifying and routing inbound leads through two channels; self service & inside sales

  • You’ll be spending most of your time with prospects across phone calls, emails and live chat on our website, as well as internal tools like slack and salesforce.

  • Your quota is measured by the number of demonstrations booked and completed at the subsequent stage of the process. Our current team in this role have achieved >=95% of their targets each month since starting

 

⚡ Challenges

  • Learning about the built world if you haven’t had any exposure to it - there are a lot of different types of companies and plenty of new terminologies to learn.

  • Up-skilling your call/phone and email skills - although we have plenty of examples for you to learn from during your onboarding.

  • Understanding SaaS financial acronyms and common terminology - if you have not worked in a SaaS company before, there is going to be a lot of metrics to learn. This cheat sheet is a good resource: The Ultimate SaaS Acronyms Cheat Sheet

  • We move very quickly, so you’ll need to be excited to come in and learn extremely fast.

 

✅ Who This Role is For

  • Ambitious individuals wanting to pursue a career in SaaS

  • People who thrive in a structured, high-agency, KPI-driven environment

  • Strong communicators who enjoy building relationships

  • Resilient individuals who can persevere and perform with high-volume tasks

 

🚫 Who This Role is Not For

  • Those unwilling to handle rejection frequently

  • People uncomfortable with people and conversations

 

🎯 Skills & Tools

Must Have:

  • Confident and clear communication skills, with excellent writing and presentation skills over email, phone, video conferencing and in-person.

  • Excellent task organization and prioritization skills, you’re able to multi-task efficiently.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with modern tooling - CRMs, Health Scoring, Live chat, Knowledge bases.

  • Experience conducting customer meetings digitally (e.g. Zoom/Teams) and/or physically (in person/face to face with customers).

  • Patience working in an industry where not all users are tech-savvy.

About Sitemate:

Sitemate builds best-in-class software and AI agents for the built world, helping construction, infrastructure and industrial companies work smarter and faster. Our mission is to multiply the engineering power of the built world.

Storm is the #1 data capture agent for the front line of the built world - converting audio, photos and videos into clean structured records.

With conversational support in-app and across SMS, Whatsapp and phone calls, Storm is shifting front line workers from paperwork and clunky digital forms, to natural language and multi-channel data capture.

Our core platforms are Dashpivot (safety, quality and field reporting), Gearbelt (fleet and asset management), Flowsite (no-code integrations), and the Sitemate mobile app for every worker on site.

We have strong product-market fit, generating thousands of new leads per month through word of mouth and organic channels. We are backed by Blackbird, with 200 people across 18+ countries and entities in Australia, the UK, the US and Canada.

 

Life at Sitemate

At Sitemate, you’ll join a team that values transparency, high velocity, hustle, diversity, and innovation - not as buzzwords, but as the principles we work by every day.

We move fast, communicate openly, and operate with trust and autonomy. You’ll have access to key company metrics, clear career development plans, and the opportunity to grow your career based on performance, not tenure.

We believe diverse teams build better products. Our team includes members from 18+ countries - 55% identify as coming from underrepresented ethnic backgrounds, 43% identify as female, and our team spans ages 22–51.

 

Our Core Values

Our core values dictate “how we work”. We believe that basic human values such as honesty, trust and integrity are required to simply ‘get in the door’. Our values are designed to help us determine if an already great person, will be a great fit at Sitemate.

  • Handle with Care: Handle with thought and care, decisions are considered and consciously delivered

  • Everything Engineered: Everything engineered, intentional, planned and systematic

  • Quality Certified: Do it well, with attention to detail and accuracy, or don’t do it at all

  • Fast Tracked: Fast, incremental, and constant delivery of change

  • High Vis: A high visibility, transparent and  open environment

  • Rain, Hail or Shine: Show up for your team, your customers and yourself

Learn more about our values:

  • Read:

    • On Sitemate's Values, Culture and DNA

  • Listen:

    • Unleashing your Zilla

    • On scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture

 

What We Offer

  • Competitive, performance-based remuneration

  • Equity options - own a piece of what you’re helping to build

  • 25 days paid annual leave, plus sick, carer’s, and compassionate leave

  • Parental leave - 16 weeks for primary and 6 weeks for secondary carers (including adoption and stillbirth support)

  • Learning & Development - professional growth budget and transparent career plans

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - for confidential counseling, mental health support, and life resources

  • Laptop and home office setup budget

  • Flexible work - a hybrid rhythm, with 2 to 3 days in office, 2 WFH each week - with the flexibility to work from anywhere for several weeks a year

  • Community & Connection - weekly catered lunches, global offsites, and “Life Story” sessions

  • London office perks - large private outdoor terrace, on-site showers & bike storage, surrounded by cafés, galleries & vibrant nightlife in the heart of Shoreditch and a 5-minute walk to Old Street tube

 

Equal Opportunity

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Sitemate welcomes applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, sexualities, and abilities. Our team’s diversity is one of our greatest strengths, and we’re committed to ensuring an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

 

Learn More About Sitemate

🎧 Podcasts

  • 2026: CRO Lance Hodgson - on why the built world is jumping straight to AI and what that changes

  • 2024: CEO Hartley Pike - on scaling Sitemate, diversity, and culture

  • 2022: CTO Tim Bray - on building quality features that solve real customer problems

💬 Want to know what it’s like to work at Sitemate? Hear it straight from the team: People of Sitemate
⭐ Read what our customers say: G2 Crowd, Trust Radius
🎥 Team Offsites: 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025

PLEASE Note:

  • We hire directly and don’t work with agencies
