jobs.title: Salgstrainee søges – bliv en del af en IT-virksomhed i vækst
jobs.description:
Er du vores næste salgstalent?

Har du lyst til at arbejde med salg, skabe stærke kunderelationer og udvikle dig i en branche med masser af muligheder?

Vi er VP Distribution, en IT-distributionsvirksomhed med base i Herlev. Vi har været på markedet i 3 år og oplever en kraftig vækst. Derfor søger vi nu en ambitiøs salgstrainee, der har lyst til at blive en del af vores fortsatte udvikling.

Vi er en mindre virksomhed med korte beslutningsveje, en fleksibel hverdag og gode muligheder for at tage ansvar og udvikle sig.

Hvad kommer du til at arbejde med?

Som salgstrainee bliver du en del af vores salgsarbejde, hvor du får mulighed for at lære salg i praksis og opbygge dine kompetencer.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Kontakte nye potentielle kunder og skabe forretningsmuligheder

  • Vedligeholde og udvikle relationer til eksisterende kunder

  • Ringe ud til kunder og følge aktivt op på salgsmuligheder

  • Rådgive kunder om IT-produkter og løsninger

  • Udarbejde tilbud og følge op på kundehenvendelser

  • Have dialog med kunder og samarbejdspartnere

  • Besøge kunder efter behov

Du får naturligvis den nødvendige oplæring. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tage initiativ og skabe resultater.

Hvem er du?

Vi leder efter et kommende salgstalent med ambitioner og lyst til at udvikle sig inden for salg.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er udadvendt og trives med at tale med mennesker

  • Ikke er bange for at tage telefonen og kontakte nye kunder

  • Er ambitiøs, initiativrig og resultatorienteret

  • Er nysgerrig, lærevillig og klar til at tage ansvar

  • Arbejder struktureret og følger dine opgaver til dørs

  • Har mod på at udfordre dig selv og lære af dine erfaringer

  • Har kørekort

Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til IT-branchen, hardware eller distribution, men det er ikke et krav.

Vi vægter din indstilling, motivation og dit potentiale højere end erfaring.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos VP Distribution får du mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og personligt i en virksomhed, hvor din indsats gør en forskel.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Fast løn plus provision

  • En fleksibel arbejdsplads

  • Grundig oplæring og mulighed for faglig udvikling

  • Ansvar og mulighed for at udvikle dig i rollen

  • Korte beslutningsveje og direkte dialog

  • En varieret hverdag med fokus på kunder og salg

  • Muligheden for at blive en del af en virksomhed i kraftig vækst

Vi har et solidt fundament og er godt på vej. Nu søger vi de rette medarbejdere til at være med til at videreudvikle forretningen og udnytte de muligheder vores vækst skaber.

Vil du være med?

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen, vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send os en kort ansøgning på info@vp-distribution.com, hvor du fortæller lidt om dig selv, din motivation og hvorfor du har lyst til at arbejde med salg hos VP Distribution.

Arbejdssted: Gammel Klausdalsbrovej 493, 2730 Herlev

Stilling: Salgstrainee

Jobtype: Fuldtid

Løn: Fast løn plus provision

Krav: Kørekort

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Optimization and Decision Support for Resilient Transport Systems
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sBackground

We invite applications for a 4-year PhD Candidate position focused on optimization and decision-support methods for resilient transport systems. The position is based at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management, located at NTNU’s campus in Trondheim.

The mission of Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management is to carry out education and research activities at a high international level in the intersection between technology/natural sciences and business economics, management, and HSE to promote sustainable value creation in technology-based areas in industry, business, and public sector organizations in Norway.

About the position

Transport systems can be disrupted by events such as floods, landslides, traffic accidents, and technical failures. These disruptions can close or constrain links in the transport network, affecting the movement of passengers and goods.

This PhD project will develop optimization methods to support strategic and operational decisions in multimodal transport systems. Strategic decisions may include infrastructure investments, resource placement, and infrastructure reinforcement. Operational decisions may include rerouting traffic, allocating capacity, and planning recovery.

You will work closely with another PhD candidate who is developing dynamic transport models and machine-learning methods to predict how the network performs under different conditions. You will integrate these models into optimization methods, allowing, for example, many scenarios and resilience measures to be evaluated efficiently.

The project addresses research questions like:

  • How can optimization support strategic investment and resource-allocation decisions for resilient transport systems?
  • How can dynamic transport models and machine-learning methods improve optimization across many possible scenarios?
  • How can optimization support rerouting, capacity allocation, and recovery decisions when parts of a transport system are unavailable?

The PhD candidate will develop models for strategic resilience planning and operational disruption management. The research will examine how to balance efficiency, redundancy, recovery, and societal requirements.

Use cases will be developed in close collaboration with project partners, including Norway’s railway infrastructure manager (Bane NOR), the Norwegian Public Roads Administration (Statens vegvesen), and the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI). The candidate will work with partners to examine practical decisions related to transport resilience.

The position offers an opportunity to develop optimization methods for important decisions about transport resilience, in collaboration with researchers in optimization, machine learning, transport modelling, infrastructure, and social sciences.

Research environment

The PhD position is part of STRIDE: Synergizing Transport Resilience, Infrastructure, and Defense in Extremes, an interdisciplinary research project involving researchers in transport modelling, machine learning, optimization, infrastructure, and social sciences.

The project studies how transport systems respond to disruptions and how modelling and decision-support methods can strengthen resilience across planning, response, and recovery. The PhD candidate will work closely with three other PhD candidates studying interdependent hazards, data-driven modelling of multimodal transport, and the societal dimensions of resilience and total defense.

The PhD candidate will be hosted at the Managerial Economics, Finance and Operations Research (BEDØK) group at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management. The group is one of Norway’s leading academic environments in operations research, logistics, optimization, and quantitative decision support. The candidate will work in close collaboration with researchers from NTNU’s Department of Computer Science and Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering.

Your role in the project
  • Conduct original scientific research related to the project topic
  • Develop optimization models and decision-support methods for resilient transport systems
  • Publish research results in leading international journals and conferences
  • Collaborate with academic and industry partners
  • Integrate dynamic transport models and machine-learning surrogates developed in a parallel PhD project into optimization methods
  • Complete the required coursework as part of the PhD programme
  • Contribute to dissemination and communication of research results
Required selection criteria
  • Applicants must hold a master’s degree in a relevant field with strong academic results (B or better according to NTNU's grading scale). Relevant academic backgrounds include:
    • Operations research or optimization
    • Applied mathematics
    • Industrial engineering
    • Transport or logistics
    • Engineering disciplines with strong quantitative and analytical content
  • Applicants must document competence in mathematical optimization, operations research, and/or related quantitative methods.
  • The position requires excellent English oral and writing skills.  

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Desired qualifications

The following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • Good knowledge of mathematical optimization, such as mixed-integer programming, stochastic programming, or robust optimization
  • Experience with optimization under uncertainty
  • Experience with algorithm development
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language, e.g, Python, Julia, C++, or similar
  • Knowledge of machine learning 

Applicants in the final phase of their master’s studies are encouraged to apply.

Personal characteristics

Personal characteristics

We are looking for a candidate who:

  • Is intellectually curious and motivated to conduct high-quality research
  • Works independently and in a structured manner
  • Has strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Thrives in interdisciplinary research environments
  • Is interested in developing research with practical relevance and societal impact

Emphasis will be placed on scientific quality, research potential, and personal suitability.

We offer
  • An exciting and international academic environment with opportunities for competence development 
  • Opportunities to collaborate with researchers in optimization, machine learning, transport modelling, and infrastructure
  • Close interaction with industry partners and public sector stakeholders
  • Participation in an interdisciplinary research project on resilient transport systems
  • Opportunities for research stays at international universities
  •  follow-up during the PhD period
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • An open and inclusive workplace  with engaged colleagues 
  • Favorable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Employee benefits
  • Good loan, insurance, and pension schemes in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)
  • Working at NTNU

Information about working and living in Norway can be found at the following link: https://www.workinnorway.no/en/Home

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 

Salary and conditions

PhD candidates are remunerated in code 1017, currently NOK 580.000,- per year before tax. From the salary, 2% is deducted as a contribution to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The employment period is 4 years, of which 3 years is for the doctoral work and 1 year for career enhancing work, such as, teaching and supervision activities.

Appointment requires admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Economics and Management at NTNU.Trondheim is the workplace. For necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The position is connected to the PhD program at the Faculty of Economics and Management, and the faculty will be your employer. Appointment to a PhD position requires that you are admitted to the PhD programme in Industrial Economics and Technology Management within three months of employment, and that you participate in an organized PhD programme during the employment period.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act.Any statutory leave will be added to the employment period.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important to stay updated on professional and organizational changes and adapt to these.

About the application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information we have at the application deadline. Therefore, ensure that your application clearly demonstrates how your skills and experiences meet the criteria described above.

The application must contain the following: 

  • Motivation letter – The motivation letter must clearly state how the candidate meets the qualification requirements.
  • Research plan (maximum one page) – Applicants should provide a brief research plan describing how they would approach one or more of the research questions outlined in the description of the position. The plan should reflect the applicant’s research interests and provide an outline of how they envision contributing to the project objectives.
  • CV, diplomas, and certificates 
  • Scientific works, including the master thesis. 
  • Names and contact information of three potential references

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU is committed to following the evaluation criteria for research quality according to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment – DORA and the commitments in CoARA (responsible research assessment and recognition of a broader range of academic contributions in line with NTNU's societal mission).

Incomplete applications will not be considered.

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

Questions about the position can be directed to Associate Professor Steffen Jaap Skotvoll Bakker, steffen.bakker@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions regarding the employment process, please contact HR Advisor Hilde Selli Egelie at hilde.s.egelie@ntnu.no.

An application including attachments should be sent electronically through www.jobbnorge.no

Application deadline: 20.11.2026 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

We conduct research and teaching at an international level in the interface between technology/natural sciences and economics, management, and HSE (health, safety and the environment). Our goal is sustainable creation of value within technology-based areas in industry, business and the public sector in Norway. We have academic groups in Trondheim and Gjøvik. jobs.title: Digital Graphic Designer
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning campaign concepts into sharp, engaging content for everything from CRM to Paid Media? And would you like to join a creative fashion environment where pace, quality and collaboration go hand in hand?

At SELECTED, we are looking for a Digital Graphic Designer to join our Brand Identity team while one of our colleagues is on maternity leave. 

YOUR TEAMYou will join our Brand Identity team and work alongside creative colleagues across graphic design, art direction, photography and other areas of brand communication.Together, we bring SELECTED's visual identity to life across channels and markets. Campaigns move quickly from idea to execution, so close collaboration, good creative sparring and the ability to keep several deliveries moving at once are part of everyday life.

YOUR ROLEYour main focus will be creating and adapting visual content for our digital channels, particularly CRM and Paid Media. You will take established concepts and translate them into strong executions across formats, platforms and markets, while keeping SELECTED's visual expression consistent.

More specifically, you will:

  • Design layouts and visual assets for newsletters and CRM campaigns.

  • Create and adapt artwork for Paid Media across platforms and formats.

  • Resize and adjust creative assets for different channels and markets.

  • Create moving content such as animations and short-form video.

  • Support the wider creative team with ad hoc graphic design tasks.

  • Help ensure a high and consistent visual standard across digital touchpoints.

YOUR BENEFITS

  • See your work go live across channels and markets, from weekly CRM campaigns to Paid Media and moving content.

  • Build breadth in your digital design experience, working across formats, platforms and different types of creative execution.

  • Join a strong creative environment, where you work closely with colleagues across design, creative and marketing and have room to contribute with your creative perspectives within SELECTED’s established visual identity and creative direction.

  • Enjoy flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home as part of our way of working.

YOUR PROFILEYou are a skilled Graphic Designer with a strong visual eye and a feel for what makes digital content engaging and on-brand. You enjoy turning creative direction into strong executions and take pride in the details that make the final result come together.

We imagine that you:

  • Have at least 2 years of experience in graphic design, preferably working with digital content.

  • Are highly skilled in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, After Effects, InDesign and Illustrator.

  • Have a strong understanding of layout, typography and visual hierarchy, and experience creating content for digital channels.

  • Work in a structured and detail-oriented way, comfortably managing several tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience with Figma, animation, motion graphics or short-form video is a plus. And if you have worked within fashion, lifestyle or another creative industry, that is an advantage too.

  • Are comfortable communicating and collaborating in English in an international working environment.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOUIf you have questions, you are welcome to contact Stephanie Widman on +45 30 85 36 42. Otherwise, send us your application, CV and portfolio as soon as possible and no later than 16 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to take the ad down, when we find the right candidate.

TERMS: The position is a one-year maternity cover with expected starting date on 1 December 2026.LOCATION: Brande, Denmark.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Planetary Atmospheric Chemistry utilizing Quantum Chemistry
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Planetary Atmospheric Chemistry utilizing Quantum Chemistry, available at Department of Chemistry, theoretical chemistry section.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.03.2027 . The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year maybe considered and it will involve 25 percent of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualification of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 

Place of work is The Life Science Building at Blindern, Oslo.

Project description

A PhD position is available at the Section for Theoretical Chemistry, Department of Chemistry, University of Oslo, within the project Molecular Atmospheric Chemistry on Alien Worlds (MACAW), funded by the Research Council of Norway.In this project we will employ quantum chemistry methods using high-performance computing (HPC) resources to study chemical reactions, photochemistry, identify spectral signatures for potential detection and elucidate condensation mechanisms for molecules in atmospheres beyond that of contemporary Earth. The project has a particular focus on Sulfur and Chlorine chemistry as well as isotopic fractionation processes.The successful applicant will have freedom to pursue specific research topics within the relatively wide project framework, in coordination with the supervisor. The work is first and foremost computational utilizing electronic structure methods to qualitatively study photochemical and thermal reaction mechanisms, as well as quantify reaction rates, UV-Vis spectra and other molecular properties relevant to studying the role of molecules in planetary atmospheres.

The work has a high degree of international collaboration within the main project supervisors' network currently spanning four continents among seven nations. This is to ensure maximal dissemination and impact of the project results, and thus the project will likely involve more than a usual amount of both hosting international visitors and travel to visit our collaborators.The project work is highly flexible, allowing the successful candidate to structure their own work.This project is an excellent opportunity for a prospective PhD candidate to make original and foundational contributions to the field of planetary atmospheric chemistry, with the potential for leading to groundbreaking discoveries of new molecules or chemical processes on other planets.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in chemistry, physics, nanoscience or related fields. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.
  • Relevant experience in utilizing computational resources and code for simulations of molecular properties
  • Experience with quantum chemistry calculations
  • Experience with scripting or programming (e.g. Python, Bash, Matlab, Fortran), and high-performance computing 

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience in electronic structure methods, e.g. DFT, coupled cluster or multireference methods
  • Background in chemical kinetics, reaction mechanisms, photochemistry, spectroscopy, transition state theory, atmospheric chemistry and/or physical chemistry
  • Any insights into planetary/exoplanetary science and photochemical atmospheric modeling 

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • A fundamental drive for scientific research, keenness/eagerness in challenging work with limited repetitiveness which requires continued learning
  • A strong interest in atmospheric, planetary and/or exoplanet science
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of an international, interdisciplinary team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks. The work is very flexible which requires discipline
  • Direct communication skills and excellent collaboration
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter - statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records (see below)
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

Hylleraas Centre for Quantum Molecular Sciences operates under the aegis of the Department of Chemistry at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. The Department of Chemistry  is Norway's largest institution within research and education in chemistry. Our research excels internationally and we educate students to a wide variety of jobs in industry, academia, research institutions, schools and public administration. Our research ranges from the core topics of chemistry to applied science within in environmental, health, energy and materials. 

The Department has extensive contacts with industry, research and educational institutions at home and abroad. As partner in the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology our researchers contributes to a significant interdisciplinary efforts in cooperation with the Department of Physics. The Department of Chemistry has its own school laboratory as a great resource for teachers, public outreach and the didactics of chemistry.

jobs.title: Facility Technical Sr. Manager
jobs.description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centers. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data center operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As Facility Technical Senior Manager, you will lead the technical MEP unit at Kvandal South outside Narvik, one of the largest AI data-centre projects in Europe. You will be central in building the unit ahead of the start of operations. You will make sure the facility’s electrical, mechanical, cooling, automation and cabling infrastructure is operated, maintained and developed safely and reliably.

 

You will report to the Facility Director and lead through an Associate Facility Technical Manager, shift managers, a project manager, technical specialists and operational support functions. Additionally, you will hold technical authority within the unit.

 

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)
  • Recruit and build the unit. Establish a structured training programme and knowledge transfer to the full technical operations team.
  • Lead technical operations around the clock, ensure adequate staffing and the right mix of competencies across all shifts to support 24/7 operations.
  • Manage preventive and corrective maintenance, and lead the technical response and fault-finding during critical incidents.
  • Participate in testing, commissioning and handover of technical installations together with Nscale. Lead the development and implementation of technical operating procedures (SOP/MOP/EOP) and governance structures, and establish technical supplier agreements.
  • Ensure safe working methods and full HSE compliance, and manage technical suppliers and contractors on quality, documentation, performance and cost.

 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

You may come from data centres, hyperscale or HPC facilities. You may also come from technical or production leadership in continuous process industry, metallurgy, pulp and paper, power generation, offshore, maritime operations or technical defence environments. A career path from an electrical, automation or mechanical specialist role into technical or maintenance leadership is particularly valuable.

You enjoy developing people, share knowledge patiently and build ownership of procedures. You drive continuous improvement through structured processes, not by departing from them.

 

Key Characteristics

  • Structured and systematic, thriving where structures, roles and requirements are clearly defined.
  • Acts in compliance with procedures, standards and regulatory requirements, and holds others to the same standard.
  • Resilient under pressure, building relationships of trust and finding pragmatic, holistic solutions.

 

Skills & Qualifications

  • Solid experience leading the operation and maintenance of complex electrical, mechanical and cooling infrastructure, with the technical depth to challenge specialists and suppliers.
  • Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary technical teams, preferably with both day and shift teams.

jobs.title: Thon Hotel Straume søker Salgssjef
jobs.description:
Salgssjef Konferanse & Bedriftsmarked

Bli med og bygg Vestlandets nye møteplass før dørene åpner!

Thon Hotel Straume | The Coastal Conference City

På Straume, bare minutter fra Bergen sentrum, bygger vi nå et av regionens mest spennende hotell- og konferanse.

I første kvartal 2029 åpner nye Thon Hotel Straume med 189 hotellrom, kapasitet for 700 konferansegjester og en storsal for opptil 300 personer.

Her får du oppleve en destinasjon hvor kystens rå energi møter byens puls og en spennende møteplass og konferansedestinasjon.

Vi kaller det The Coastal Conference City.

Nå ser vi etter salgssjefen som skal være med å bygge markedet lenge før bygget står ferdig.

Er du komfortabel med å selge en visjon?

Dette er ikke en tradisjonell salgsrolle.

De neste årene skal du fylle ordreboken for et hotell og konferanseanlegg som fortsatt er under bygging. Du må klare å få kunder til å se det vi ser. Du må kunne tegne bildene, fortelle historien og skape entusiasme for en destinasjon som vokser frem måned for måned.

Vi ser etter deg som tror på prosjektet, ser mulighetene i Øygarden og evner å gjøre våre fremtidige gjester like begeistret som vi er.

Du blir en sentral del av prosjektet og får følge utviklingen fra byggeplass til ferdig destinasjon samt en del av hotellets ledergruppe.

Hva skal du gjøre?

Du får ansvaret for å etablere og utvikle konferanse- og bedriftsmarkedet for nye Thon Hotel Straume.

Dette innebærer blant annet å:

  • Bygge og utvikle en solid portefølje av bedriftskunder og samarbeidspartnere

  • Selge møter, konferanser, arrangementer og hotellavtaler flere år frem i tid

  • Bygge opp ordreboken mot åpningen i 2029

  • Utvikle relasjoner innen MICE-markedet (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Events)

  • Jobbe med hotellavtaler, prosjektavtaler og langsiktige rammeavtaler

  • Gjennomføre kundemøter, presentasjoner, nettverksaktiviteter og befaringer

  • Samarbeide tett med drift, booking og ledelse om produkter, konsepter og kommersiell utvikling

  • Være en ambassadør for både Thon Hotel Straume, The Coastal Conference City og destinasjonen Øygarden

Hvem ser vi etter?

Du er en relasjonsbygger som motiveres av å åpne dører og skape nye muligheter.

Du trives når målet ligger langt fremme, og du lar deg ikke stoppe av at bygget fortsatt er under oppføring.

Kanskje jobber du allerede med hotellsalg, konferansesalg eller annen kompleks B2B-salg. Kanskje kommer du fra reiseliv, opplevelser eller prosjektbasert salg.

Det viktigste er at du:

  • Har dokumenterte resultater innen salg

  • Trives med oppsøkende salgsarbeid

  • Er strukturert og god på langsiktig oppfølging

  • Evner å bygge tillit og relasjoner på alle nivåer

  • Har kommersiell forståelse og ser verdien i gode kundeavtaler

  • Er en inspirerende historieforteller som kan selge både visjon og virkelighet

  • Har tro på Øygarden som destinasjon og mulighetene prosjektet representerer

Hvorfor velge oss?

Fordi dette er en sjelden mulighet.

Du får være med helt fra starten og sette ditt preg på et av regionens mest spennende hotell- og konferanseprosjekter.

Du blir med på å skrive neste kapittel i hotelleventyret på Straume.

Du får påvirke strategi, kundeportefølje og markedsposisjon.

Og når dørene åpner i 2029, vil du kunne se tilbake på noe få salgsledere får oppleve:

At du var med på å bygge markedet før produktet eksisterte.

Vi tilbyr

  • En unik rolle i utviklingen av The Coastal Conference City

  • Muligheten til å bygge opp konferansemarkedet fra grunnen av

  • Et sterkt fagmiljø og en av Norges mest solide merkevarer i ryggen

  • Stor frihet og påvirkningskraft

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

  • Arbeidssted ved Thon Hotel Straume

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Våre virksomhetsområder

Thon Gruppen er et av Norges største privateide konsern, eid av Thon Stiftelsen. Vi driver innen hotell, eiendom, og servering, og har rundt 3 000 årsverk.

Vi er engasjert i:

Thon Hotels: En av Norges største hotellkjeder, med over 90 hoteller i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Belgia og Nederland.

Thon Eiendom: Norges største private eiendomsaktør med utleie og salg av bolig- og næringseiendom, samt drift av over 80 kjøpesentre i Norge og Sverige.

Resthon: Vår serveringsvirksomhet med barer og restauranter – fra gastropuber til spillkonsepter – med fokus på god mat og god stemning. Les mer

    Omsetningen i 2024 var ca. 13,9 milliarder kroner. Les mer om konsernet her: thon.no/om

    Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?
    • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med fokus på bærekraft og langsiktighet
    • Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter, med fokus på intern rekruttering
    • Mulighet til å jobbe i et konsern med stor bredde og mange ulike roller

    Vi er opptatt av mangfold og likestilling, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uansett alder, kjønn, bakgrunn eller funksjonsevne.

    Les mer om hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss: thon.no/karriere

    Samfunnsansvar og bærekraft

    Gjennom Thon Stiftelsen og i vår daglige drift jobber vi aktivt med:

    • Deltakelse i FNs Global Compact
    • Miljøfyrtårn-sertifisering av våre hoteller
    • Reduksjon av matsvinn
    • Fokus på likestilling og mangfold
    • Støtte til forskning og allmennyttige formål

jobs.title: Sanitør til skadeservice | bliv en del af Ocab i Aarhus
jobs.description:
Når andre oplever en af deres værste dage, er du med til at gøre en forskelHos Ocab hjælper vi mennesker og virksomheder videre efter brand-, vand- ogskimmelskader. Vi søger nu en sanitør til vores afdeling i Aarhus, som har lyst tilen hverdag med mening, ansvar og gode kolleger.Du bliver en del af et engageret team med stor erfaring inden for skadeservice.Sammen arbejder I for at sikre, at vores kunder hurtigt kan vende tilbage til ennormal hverdag.

Om jobbet

Som sanitør hos Ocab bliver du en vigtig del af indsatsen, når skaden er sket. Duarbejder både selvstændigt og sammen med dine kolleger, og du får en varierethverdag med opgaver hos både private, virksomheder og forsikringsselskaber.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Blotlægning og nedrivning i forbindelse med vandskader

  • Skimmelsanering

  • Opsætning og tilsyn med affugtningsudstyr

  • Dokumentation af opgaver fra start til slut

  • Deltagelse i vores døgnvagtsordning

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere

  • Asbestsanering

  • Sanering efter skadedyr

  • Rengøring og sanering efter brandskader

  • Oprydning og rengøring i forbindelse med socialsager

Vi forestiller os, at du

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag, men vi håber, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra skadeservice eller lignende branche – erfaring medskadeservice vil være en klar fordel

  • Har asbestbevis eller erfaring med asbestsanering (en fordel, men ikke etkrav)

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Er kvalitetsbevidst og sætter en ære i et godt stykke arbejde

  • Trives i et team, hvor man hjælper hinanden

  • Har en positiv indstilling og bidrager til et godt samarbejde

  • Er fleksibel og bevarer overblikket – også når der er travlt

  • Bor i rimelig afstand til vores afdeling i Aarhus (gerne inden for ca. 30-40 km)

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har kørekort (kategori B)

Det er en forudsætning, at du kan fremvise straffeattest.

Vi ved, at den rette kollega kan have forskellige erfaringer med sig. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rigtige indstilling, tager ansvar og har lyst til at lære.

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice ogindustriservice. Vi hjælper hvert år tusindvis af kunder efter blandt andet brand-,vand- og klimaskader.Hos os bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed, moderne udstyr ogengagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde,ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og afvekslende hverdag

  • Grundig oplæring og gode udviklingsmuligheder

  • Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger

  • Løn efter overenskomst

  • Pension og sundhedsordning

  • 37 timers arbejdsuge

  • Normal arbejdstid mandag-fredag kl. 07.00-15.00

  • Deltagelse i døgnvagtsordning

Arbejdssted: Ocab Aarhus afdelingen, Haslegårdsvænget 16, 8210 Aarhus

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rettekandidat.Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@ocab.dk.Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakt afdelingsleder Anders T. Madsen påtlf. +45 55 66 68 41.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Kunnossapidon tiiminvetäjä Salicolle
jobs.description: Haemme Salico Oy:lle kunnossapidon tiiminvetäjää toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen Helsingin Kivikossa sijaitsevalle elintarviketuotantolaitokselle. Salico valmistaa tuoreita hedelmä- ja vihannesjalosteita sekä monipuolisia food-to-go-tuotteita, kuten salaatteja, wrappeja ja leipiä. Osana Picadeli Groupia Salico toimii tuoreiden elintarvikkeiden ja valmiiden ateriaratkaisujen parissa.Kunnossapidon tiiminvetäjänäpääset varmistamaan tuotantolaitoksen koneiden ja laitteiden toimintavarmuutta sekä kehittämään kunnossapidon toimintaa osana elintarviketeollisuuden vaativaa tuotantoympäristöä. Tuotannossa yhdistyvät moderni tuotantoteknologia, automaatio ja tarkasti valvotut prosessit, joissa laadulla, hygienialla ja elintarviketurvallisuudella on keskeinen merkitys.Työtehtäviisi kuuluukunnossapitotöiden suunnittelu ja koordinointi, työmenetelmien kehittäminen ja standardointi sekä toimintatapojen kouluttaminen. Vastaat kunnossapidon toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän ylläpidosta ja kehittämisestä sekä varaosien hallinnoinnista. Osallistut myös vikaselvityksiin ja tarvittaessa akuutteihin korjauksiin. Tehtävässä pääset yhdistämään käytännön teknisen osaamisen, ennakoivan kunnossapidon ja toiminnan jatkuvan kehittämisen.Kunnossapitotiimiin kuuluu neljä asentajaa, jotka työskentelevät kahdessa porrastetussa vuorossa. Kunnossapitotoiminnot on ulkoistettu, joten tehtävään ei kuulu suoraa esihenkilövastuuta. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä tuotannon työnjohdon ja tuotannonsuunnittelun kanssa ja raportoit tekniselle päällikölle.Odotamme sinultatehtävään soveltuvaa sähkö- ja automaatiotekniikan koulutusta sekä kokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta. Sinulla on käytännönläheinen ja järjestelmällinen ote työhön, ja ymmärrät ennakoivan kunnossapidon sekä kunnonvalvonnan merkityksen tuotantolaitteiden toimintavarmuudelle. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä kykyä koordinoida kunnossapitotöitä kustannustehokkaasti. Työturvallisuus, elintarviketurvallisuus ja laatu ohjaavat kaikkea tekemistä tuotantoympäristössä. Odotamme henkilöltä sujuvaa suomen ja hyvää englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.Eduksi katsommekokemuksen kunnossapidon toiminnanohjausjärjestelmistä ja niiden kehittämisestä sekä osaamisen työmenetelmien standardoinnista. Myös kiinteistötekniikan tuntemus on tehtävässä hyödyksi.Tarjoammemonipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän elintarviketeollisuuden tuotantolaitoksessa, jossa kunnossapidolla on tärkeä rooli tuotannon sujuvuuden, laadun ja toimintavarmuuden varmistamisessa. Pääset kehittämään kunnossapidon prosesseja, vaikuttamaan ennakoivan kunnossapidon toteutumiseen ja työskentelemään modernin tuotantoteknologian parissa. Tarjoamme toistaiseksi voimassa olevan työsuhteen, jossa yhdistyvät tekninen asiantuntemus, käytännön ongelmanratkaisu ja yhteistyö tuotannon eri toimintojen kanssa.Mikäli kiinnostuittehtävästä, hae mukaan ja tule kehittämään Salicon kunnossapitoa osana tuoreiden elintarvikkeiden tuotantoa! Haethan tehtävään oheisen linkin kautta. Aloitamme hakemusten jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Töiden aloitus tapahtuu sopimuksen mukaan. Huomaathan että emme käsittele sähköpostilla lähetettyjä hakemuksia tietoturvasyistä.Lisätietoja Baronalta antaa Ari Kumlander, ari.kumlander@barona.fiRekrytointitoteutetaan yhteistyössä Baronan kanssa. Kaikki yhteydenotot rekrytointiin liittyen tulee tehdä Baronalle.

jobs.description: Meiltä löytyy toimeksiantoja täyttämään uudenkin välittäjän työpäiviä! Tarjoamme sinulle paikan kasvavasta organisaatiosta, jossa pääset itse vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi. Saat meiltä hyvät työkalut ja tuen työssäsi menestymiseen.Etsimämme henkilö on motivoitunut ja positiivinen tiimipelaaja, jolta löytyy kyky laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen tuottamiseen. Edellytämme tehtävään valitulta henkilöltä suoritettua LVV- tai LKV-tutkintoa. Osaat aikatauluttaa omaa työntekoasi ja työskentelet tarkalla otteella. Pystyt työskentelemään asiakkaiden kanssa tarvittaessa myös englanniksi. Koska saat pitkälti suunnitella omien työpäiviesi aikataulun, toivomme, että pystyt myös itse tarpeen tullen joustamaan. Työ on lähtökohtaisesti osa-aikaista, mutta mahdollisuus myös kokoaikaiseen työhön. Oma auto on tässä työssä välttämätön.Teemme välitystyötä modernilla otteella, suunnitelmallisesti ja jatkuvasti uudistuen. Toivomme, että sinulla on niin osaamista kuin halua erilaisten digitaalisten välineiden ja järjestelmien kuin sosiaalisen mediankin hyödyntämiseen.Meidän rennossa ja ammattitaitoisessa työyhteisössä on helppo viihtyä. Saat aina tarvittaessa myös apua työkavereilta. Tulet saamaan työnantajan puolesta jonkin verran toimeksiantoja, jotta aloitus meillä olisi mahdollisimman sujuvaa.Joustavan työajan lisäksi tarjoamme kannustavan provisiopalkkauksen ja korvaamme myös oman auton käytöstä johtuvat kilometrit. Työsuhde-etuna pääset seuraamaan asuntosijoittamista läheltä ja ensimmäisenä mukaan sijoitusasuntojen tarjouksiimme.Hakuaika on 2.-15.11.2026. Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana. Tehtävän aloitusajankohta sopimuksen mukaan. Työhön valitulta tarkistetaan luottotiedot.Lähetä CV ja työhakemuksesi viimeistään 15.11.2026 osoitteeseen karoliina.peltola@asuntopehtoori.fi otsikolla Välittäjän rekry/Lappeenranta.Kysy tehtävästä lisää: Karoliina Peltola, tiimipäällikkö, karoliina.peltola@asuntopehtoori.fi, 044 768 0122

jobs.title: Datainsinööri Tietohallinto
jobs.description: Haluatko olla mukana kehittämässä tulevaisuuden terveydenhuoltoa? Etsimme ehkä juuri sinua Datainsinööriksi vakituiseen työsuhteeseen HUSin Tietohallintoon!HUSin Tietohallinto on aktiivinen toimija, joka kehittää ja ottaa käyttöön uusia innovaatioita terveydenhuollon toimialalla. Tietohallinto on HUSin tulosyksikkö ja se toimittaa tietojärjestelmä-, tietotekniikka- ja viestintätekniikkapalveluita sekä tietotekniikan laitevuokrausta pääsääntöisesti HUS-yhtymälle, yhtymän yhteistyökumppaneille sekä tytär- ja osakkuusyhteisöille. Meillä pääset työskentelemään Suomen suurimman terveydenhuoltoalan toimijan strategisen IT-osaamisen parissa ja kehittämään tulevaisuuden terveydenhuoltoa. Miksi HUS? * Merkityksellinen työ: Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan terveydenhuollon tulevaisuuteen ja parantamaan ihmisten elämänlaatua. * Tasapaino työn ja vapaa-ajan välillä: Tarjoamme joustavat työajat, mahdollisuuden etätyöhön ja kilpailukykyisen palkan. * Ammattitaitoinen ja mukava työyhteisö: Meillä työskentelee huippuosaajia, jotka tukevat ja inspiroivat toisiaan. Tehtävän kuvausHaemme nyt datainsinööriä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Tietohallinnon Data, AI ja analytiikka -vastuualueen Tietoallas- ja tietotuotantopalvelut -vastuuyksikköön.Data, AI ja analytiikka -vastuualueella kehitämme tulevaisuuden terveydenhuoltoa. Missionamme on tehdä terveydenhuollosta entistä tehokkaampaa ja vaikuttavampaa sekä luoda datalla arvoa. HUSin tietoallasta on kehitetty edelläkävijänä jo kymmenen vuoden ajan, ja datan rooli HUSin toimintojen kehittämisessä on kaiken ytimessä.Meillä työskentelee huippuosaajia datan, tekoälyn, tiedolla johtamisen ja tutkimuksen saralla monipuolisissa rooleissa, kuten analyytikkoina, kehittämispäällikköinä, tuotepäällikköinä ja tietoarkkitehteina. Osaajiamme motivoi merkityksellinen työ, ja etsimme aktiivisesti lisää työkavereita datan, analytiikan ja tekoälykehittämisen saralla. Tulevaisuuden sote rakennetaan datalla!Tietoallas- ja tietotuotantopalvelut -vastuuyksikössä työskentelee vajaa 20 datan, datainfrastruktuurin ja analytiikan asiantuntijaa. Yksikkömme vastaa HUSin tietoalustasta, joka pitää sisällään tietoaltaan, tietovaraston sekä raportointiympäristön HUS-laajuiselle raportoinnille. Tietoallas- ja tietotuotantopalvelut yksikössä pääset mukaan kehittämään ja ylläpitämään yhtä Euroopan suurinta terveysdatan data-alustaa yhdessä timanttisen tiimin kanssa.Haettavassa tehtävässä toimit osana HUSin tietoallas- ja tietotuotantoyksikkö, ja sen Data Engineering -tiimiä. Tehtävänäsi on kehittää ja ylläpitää datan käsittelyyn liittyviä prosesseja ja dataputkia. Osallistut aktiivisesti tietoaltaan teknisten kyvykkyyksien ja datan laadun kehittämiseen, tuoden esiin uusia näkökulmia ja parannusehdotuksia erityisesti infrastruktuuriin ja teknisiin kokonaisuuksiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä. Osallistut tiimisi kanssa datan mallinnukseen liittyviin suunnittelu- ja kehitystehtäviin koko tietoalustan tasolla, mukaan lukien tietoallas, tietovarasto ja raportointiympäristö. Tuet osaltasi tietoalustan kehitystä ja varmistat että HUSilla käytössä olevat ratkaisut palvelevat tehokkaasti liiketoiminnan tarpeita, sekä tukevat organisaation kokonaisstrategiaa.Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää * Ohjelmointitaitoja (esim. Python, Scala, SQL, Spark) * Osaamista tietoarkkitehtuurista, pilviteknologioista ja pilviarkkitehtuurista * Osaamista Microsoft Azuren ympäristöstä sekä Databricksistä * Kykyä kommunikoida selkeästi suomeksi ja englanniksi * Hyviä priorisointitaitoja ja paineensietokykyä.Arvostamme * Kokemusta ketterien kehitysmenetelmin hyödyntämisessä * Kokemusta terveydenhuollon käsitteistä ja tietomallinnuksesta * Ymmärrystä eri tiedon mallintamismenetelmistä ja metodologioista * Innovointikyvykkyyttä tiedolla johtamisen kehittämisessä * Sitoutumista yhteisiin toimintamalleihin ja laatutyöhön * Kykyä tiimityöskentelyyn sekä itsenäiseen- ja asiakastarvelähtöiseen ohjautuvuuteen muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä * Intoa kehittää HUSin työyhteisöä ja työkulttuuria kohti entistä ketterämpää ja tehokkaampaa toimintaa.Me tarjoamme sinulle * Itsenäisen ja vastuullisen työn, jossa pääset johtamaan omaa työtäsi * Joustavan työajan ja hyvän työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainon * Asiantuntevan ja mukavan työyhteisön, jossa kehitetään jatkuvasti työskentelytapoja ja työkulttuuria * Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa Suomen suurimman erikoissairaanhoidon palvelujen tarjoajan toiminnan kehittämiseen * Ammattitaitoista, empaattista ja inhimillistä johtamista * Mahdollisuuden kehittää ja modernisoida HUSin toimintakulttuuria * Kilpailukykyisen palkan ja mukavat työajat * Työn, jolla on todellista merkitystä: Me huslaiset olemme sitoutuneet terveydenhuollon palvelujen kehittämiseen ja pääsemme päivittäin tekemään töitä ihmisten hyvinvoinnin tukemiseksi.Virkaan tai tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä voidaan tehdä hakijan suostumuksella henkilöturvallisuusselvitys (turvallisuusselvityslaki 726/2014). Turvallisuusselvitysmenettelystä ja selvityksen kohteen oikeuksista löytyy tarkempia tietoja osoitteessawww.supo.fi.Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 4806,69 €/kk ja mahdolliset kokemus- ja muut lisät. Työ voi alkaa 4.1.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana sopivien henkilöiden löytyessä.Hae meille hakuajan loppuun mennessä. HUSissa olet osa vaikuttavinta hoitoa.Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdotSoveltuva korkeakoulututkinto tai soveltuva opistotutkinto ja soveltuva kokemus.Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.YhteystiedotLisätietoja tehtävästä antaa vastuuyksikön päällikön sijainen Ossi Syd, ext-ossi.syd@hus.fitai vastuualueen johtaja Sara Kinnunen, sara.kinnunen@hus.fi.Hakemukset liitteineen tulee jättää sähköisen järjestelmän kautta.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

  • Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

  • Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

  • Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

  • Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

  • Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

  • You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

  • You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

  • You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

jobs.description: Sustainable Finance Project ManagerPermanent contract (CDI), full-time | Start: as soon as possible | Location: LuxembourgThe roleDo you enjoy bringing order to complex projects, following up on every action, and taking pride in documents that are clear, accurate and well-written? The LSFI is looking for a Sustainable Finance Project Manager to run its multi-stakeholder platforms, which bring together seniordecision-makers from the public and private sectors of the Luxembourg financial centre. You will work under the supervision of the Head of Sustainable Finance.As the central point of contact between the LSFI team and its stakeholders, advisory boards and working group members, you will make sure that every meeting is well prepared, every discussion is accurately recorded and every agreed action is followed through to completion.What you will do• Stakeholder Forum: organise the LSFI Stakeholder Forum from start to finish (dates, agendas, presentations, minutes) and use participant feedback to improve each edition.• Advisory Bodies (IIAB and SAB): run their secretariat together with their Chair and Vice Chair, and track agreed actions until they are completed.• Women in Finance (WiF) Charter: onboard new signatories, manage the annual data collection campaign, coordinate the Steering Committee and the founders, and steer the annual progress report through to publication with the data provider and consultant.• Working Groups and Taskforces: launch new groups on topics selected by Management, run their secretariat with the Chair and Vice Chair, and keep members focused on tangible outcomes.• Support the Head of Sustainable Finance: Contribute to other LSFI projects as assigned by the Head of Sustainable Finance (including but not limited to coordination, planning of activities, participating in events, desk-top research) and to the day-to-day activities of the team.What we expect from you• Outstanding organisation: you plan ahead, take ownership, and drive several projects in parallel and meet deadlines.• Attention to detail and precision: accuracy matters to you, whether in a set of minutes, a data file or a slide.• Excellent writing skills: you draft clear, concise and well-structured agendas, minutes, emails and reports, and you can summarise complex discussions.• Diplomacy and firmness: you are at ease with senior stakeholders and remain courteous but persistent on follow-ups and deadlines.• Adaptability: you handle shifting priorities calmly without losing sight of the essentials.Qualifications and experience• Master's degree (or equivalent) in business, finance, communications, political science or a related field.• At least 2 years of experience in project management, stakeholder coordination or a secretariat role, ideally in an association, a public body or the financial sector.• Genuine interest in sustainable finance; knowledge of the Luxembourg financial centre and experience in the field of sustainable finance are an advantage.• Excellent command of English, written and spoken; German, French and/or Luxembourgish are an advantage.• Advanced proficiency in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).Who we areThe Luxembourg Sustainable Finance Initiative (LSFI) (www.lsfi.lu) is Luxembourg's coordinating entity on Sustainable Finance. Acting as a centre of excellence and knowledge hub, it works with the whole financial ecosystem to accelerate the financing of the transition, with the ambition of making Luxembourg a global centre for sustainable finance. Guided by its Sustainable Finance Strategy 2030, the LSFI:• Builds expertise and leadership: acts as Luxembourg's expert on sustainable finance topics and regulation, sharing insights with financial institutions and policymakers and raising Luxembourg's international profile;• Mobilises the financial sector: runs working groups, taskforces and advisory boards, and drives initiatives such as the Women in Finance Charter to unlock high-impact, innovative projects;• Measures and communicates progress: publishes the annual Luxembourg Sustainable Finance Study, maintains a Resource Hub on regulation, standards and labels, and organises events such as the annual LSFI Summit and Masterclasses.The LSFI was founded in January 2020 by the Luxembourg Government (Ministry of Finance and Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Biodiversity), Luxembourg for Finance (the agency for the development of the financial centre) and the High Council for Sustainable Development (Conseil Supérieur pour un Développement Durable).What we offer• A role at the heart of the Luxembourg sustainable finance ecosystem, working closely with key public and private decision-makers and experts in the field.• A small, committed team where initiative is valued and where you will be involved in many aspects of our work.• Flexible working hours and access to training in sustainable finance.• A gross annual salary between EUR 45,000 and EUR 55,000, depending on qualifications and experience.How to applySend your CV and cover letter via e-mail.As writing is central to this role, the quality of your cover letter will be part of our assessment.Submission deadline: 30 November 2026

with data protection requirements and BDO policies.• Business Development: Actively contribute to the acquisition of new clients and the expansion of existing relationships by leveraging your professional network, market knowledge and understanding of clients' evolving needs.• Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with other BDO service lines to identify opportunities and deliver integrated solutions that address clients' accounting, tax and broader business challenges.  This position is for you if: • You are a qualified accountant or are close to obtaining the qualification.• development opportunities.• You are highly organized, detail-oriented and capable of managing multiple priorities while meeting deadlines and maintaining high-quality standards.• You demonstrate an jobs.title: Er du ambitiøs og har arbejdet med salg, telemarketing eller marketing? Så bliv en del af vores team i Barcelona.
jobs.description:
Vi søger en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist til vores internationale kontor i Barcelona - Opstart den 9. november.

Har du arbejdet med salg, telemarketing eller marketing i mere end et år og er klar til næste skridt i din karriere? Eller brænder du for digital markedsføring, er kreativ og vil gerne certificeres som konsulent, der hjælper virksomheder med at skabe succesfulde digitale kampagner?

Hvis du er teknisk stærk, kreativ og udadvendt — og samtidig trives i et tempofyldt og foranderligt miljø — så har vi måske det perfekte job til dig.

Hvad laver en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?

Du arbejder tæt sammen med ambitiøse virksomheder, der skal onboardes til digital vækst. Du rådgiver om Pay-Per-Click-kampagner (PPC), identificerer vækstmuligheder og skaber langsigtet værdi. Med forståelse for markedsdynamik og strategisk tænkning styrker du system integrering og kundeloyalitet — med effekt og relation i centrum.

Skaber vækst og digitale resultater

Du udvikler og optimerer kampagner, opsøger kunder via telefon og video, og identificerer løsninger, der matcher deres unikke behov. Du opbygger tillid og sikrer, at dine kunder får det fulde udbytte af deres digitale investeringer — både på kort og lang sigt.

Styrker kunderejser og partnerskaber

Du håndterer et højt volumen af kunder og rådgiver i komplekse kontekster. Du arbejder med strategier, der øger ROI og kampagnespend, og bistår med integration på tværs af platforme. Du bruger AI-værktøjer i din dagligdag og kommunikerer effektivt med forskellige interessenter — altid med respekt for datasikkerhed og GDPR.

Du bliver en del af et globalt team i hjertet af Barcelona, hvor teknologi og marketing mødes. 

Engelsktalende arbejdsmiljø er standard, og du får fuldt betalt oplæring, personlige coaches og adgang til certificeringer. Stillingen åbner døre til intern karriereudvikling og spændende projekter inden for digital markedsføring.

Dit ansvar:

  • Onboarding af kunder og opbygning af langsigtede relationer over telefon og videomøder

  • Udvikling af performance-drevne PPC-strategier

  • Proaktivt salg og kampagneoptimering

  • Opdatering og vedligeholdelse af kundedata

  • Rådgivning om digital positionering og annoncering

  • Forståelse for ROI og integration med andre platforme

  • Support og strategisk planlægning på nordisk niveau

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Dansk og engelsk på minimum C1

  • Bachelorgrad eller relevant erfaring i marketing/salg/Telemarketing

  • Kendskab til Google Ads, CRM og datastyring

  • Proaktiv og strategisk tilgang til kundeopgaver

  • Evne til at navigere i komplekse stakeholder-miljøer

  • Passion for digital markedsføring og forretningsudvikling

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav — hvis rollen vækker din interesse, opfordrer vi dig stadig til at søge!

Benefits:

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling (39 timer/uge) med hybridmodel i Barcelona

  • Flyttepakke med flybillet og indkvartering i privat studie

  • Privat sygeforsikring og sundhedsfokus

  • Bonus for at anbefale en ven

  • Certificeringer og løbende kompetenceudvikling

  • Arbejdsmiljø med sociale aktiviteter og teambuilding

  • Kontor med havudsigt i World Trade Center, Barcelona

Hvad får du ud af at tage afsted?

Barcelona byder på solrige dage, strandliv og kreativ energi. Her kan du nyde tapas ved havet, arbejde med banebrydende teknologi og udvikle dig både personligt og professionelt i et byliv, der aldrig står stille. Derudover får du:

  • Lavere leveomkostninger end Danmark

  • Kunst, musik, tech og kultur i dynamisk samspil

  • Fokus på trivsel og diversitet

  • Internationale brands og karrieremuligheder

  • Åben og inkluderende atmosfære

Professionel udvikling:

  • Indsigt i digital markedsføring og internationale arbejdskulturer

  • Specialiseret viden om Google Ads og online strategi

  • Fuld oplæring og adgang til certificeringer

  • Karriereveje inden for tech, salg og rådgivning

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med kunder fra hele Europa

Personlig vækst og karriere:

Forestil dig at starte dagen med café con leche, arbejde med digitale strategier under palmerne og slutte af med live-musik ved stranden. Hos TP får du ikke bare et job — du får muligheden for at bygge en karriere, forme fremtiden og leve livet fuldt ud.

Barcelona er stedet, hvor arbejde og livskvalitet går op i en højere enhed.

Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

jobs.title: Senior Application Carve-out Lead / Specialist
jobs.description:
For our client were looking for 2 Senior Application Carve-out Lead / Specialists capable of independently driving assigned application separation activities from planning through execution and validation.

The resources will work closely with Service Managers, application vendors, business stakeholders, project teams and other IT teams. The overall objective is to add independent execution capacity to the team and reduce the amount of day-to-day carve-out planning, coordination and hands-on execution currently performed by Service Managers.

Scope: Dedicated demerger resources supporting application portfolios currently managed by IT Service Managers.

Resource 1- Support for Group Finance applications HFM Hyperion, IPM Anaplan, Tagetik, Workiva
Resource 2 - Support for project FX hedging and calculation application PROFIT

The resource is expected to:
· Take end-to-end ownership of assigned application carve-out activities.
· Establish and maintain the application-level carve-out plan, activities, dependencies and readiness. · Identify dependencies related to applications, integrations, data, environments, users/access, infrastructure, vendors and other solutions.
· Coordinate target environment and solution setup activities with relevant internal and external stakeholders.
· Drive technical and functional separation activities through testing, cutover and validation.
· Coordinate vendors and other technical resources required to complete the separation.
· Proactively identify gaps, risks, issues and required decisions.
· Ensure that required technical and operational documentation is created and maintained.
· Support solution handover and operational readiness after separation.
· Escalate to the Service Manager primarily when business/application-specific decisions, prioritization or escalation are required.

The resource should drive the work rather than only coordinate and report it.

Expected background and capabilities:
· Strong experience in enterprise application lifecycle, implementation, migration or separation activities.
· Previous experience in IT carve-outs, demergers, M&A integrations or comparable application transformation programs is strongly preferred.
· Good understanding of enterprise applications and their dependencies, including integrations, data flows, identity/access, environments and vendors.
· Experience in planning and executing testing, deployment, cutover and validation activities.
· Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, application owners, vendors and cross-functional IT teams in an international environment.
· Strong documentation and structured problem-solving capabilities.
· Self-driven, proactive and hands-on way of working.
· Ability to independently structure ambiguous topics and drive them towards resolution.
· Fluent written and spoken English.

Key success criterion: The resource must be capable of independently taking ownership of an application/workstream and driving the carve-out forward without requiring continuous operational steering from the Service Manager.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Have you independently led end-to-end application carve-out, separation, demerger, or M&A-related activities, from planning through cutover and validation?Kyllä

- Do you have hands-on experience managing dependencies across applications, integrations, data, environments, identity/access, infrastructure, vendors, and business stakeholders?
- Have you been responsible for planning and driving application testing, deployment, cutover, validation, and operational handover as part of a separation or transformation?*

Please apply with your updated CV in English, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. We offer continuously, which means that we sometimes remove the assignments before deadline. If you are interested, we recommend that you apply immediately.

jobs.title: Researcher der er mere 7-kantet end 4-kantet.
jobs.description:
PASSER DU IKKE IND I DE NORMALE KASSER ?Researcher & Faktachecker.Vi søger syvkantede mennesker, der ikke nødvendigvis passer ind i firkantede bokse.Ikke fordi du er unormal. Men fordi dine kompetencer, din personlighed og din måde at arbejde på måske passer bedre til funktioner, som ikke ligner de traditionelle stillinger.Hos MinBy™ er vi ikke specielt optagede af, om du passer ind i en bestemt stillingsbetegnelse.Vi er langt mere interesserede i, hvad du kan, hvad du brænder for, og hvad du kan blive rigtig dygtig til.Måske er du netop den person, vi mangler.

VI ARBEJDER 100 % REMOTE – OG MENER DET!Vi har ingen traditionel arbejdsplads, du skal møde ind på.Vi sidder spredt rundt omkring i hele kongeriget – og enkelte af os arbejder endda fra udlandet.Vi skriver rigtig meget sammen. Vi taler endnu mere sammen.Men vi ses aldrig fysisk – heller ikke via kamera.Det lyder måske usædvanligt. Det er det også.Til gengæld fungerer det for os.

Vi er et lille team, der arbejder tæt sammen, selvom vi sidder vidt forskellige steder.Du arbejder hjemmefra eller fra et andet fast, privat arbejdssted, hvor du har ro og de rigtige arbejdsforhold.Vi forventer, at du møder til tiden, arbejder struktureret, overholder aftaler og normalt afslutter arbejdsdagen til tiden.Du skal ikke bevise dit engagement ved at arbejde døgnet rundt.Du skal bevise det gennem det, du leverer.

MÅSKE ER DU EN AF DEM, VI LEDER EFTER?Du er måske typen, der:

  • Har det bedst med at arbejde hjemmefra og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Er passioneret, nysgerrig og engageret i det, du laver.

  • Kan arbejde struktureret uden en chef, der kigger dig over skulderen.

  • Trives med tæt digital kommunikation og løbende sparring.

  • Har kompetencer, der går på tværs af flere traditionelle jobfunktioner.

  • Gerne vil lære nyt og ikke er bange for AI, automatisering og nye arbejdsmetoder.

  • Sætter pris på stabilitet, fleksibilitet og et team, hvor man hjælper hinanden.

Måske har du tidligere oplevet, at traditionelle arbejdspladser ikke passer særligt godt til dig.Det kan skyldes din bopæl, lang transporttid, familiemæssige forhold eller ganske enkelt, at du arbejder bedst i dine egne omgivelser.For os er det ikke en ulempe. Det kan tværtimod være en fordel.

Vi vil gerne give plads til mennesker, som har både evnerne, lysten og arbejdsmoralen, men som ikke nødvendigvis passer ind i den traditionelle arbejdsmodel.

HVILKEN STILLING SØGER DU EGENTLIG?Det behøver du ikke nødvendigvis vide endnu.Vi har flere forskellige funktioner og arbejdsområder, og vi forventer at udvide teamet med mindst to nye medarbejdere.Du kan også læse vores mere traditionelle stillingsopslag, hvor vi beskriver de enkelte funktioner.Men dette opslag er anderledes.Her søger vi først mennesket og kompetencerne. Derefter finder vi den rigtige funktion.

Måske passer du ind i én af vores eksisterende stillinger.Måske har du en kombination af kompetencer, der gør dig interessant til flere funktioner.Og måske opdager vi sammen en mulighed, vi endnu ikke har defineret.

LØN OG ARBEJDSVILKÅRHvis du kommer forholdsvis ny ind i et arbejdsområde og skal læres op, er vores udgangspunkt en månedsløn på 26.000 kr. efter endt prøvetid ved fuldtidsansættelse.Har du allerede stærke kompetencer, relevant erfaring eller andre lønforventninger, er vi åbne for at drøfte en individuel aftale.Vi foretrækker klart kandidater, der ser vores arbejdsform som en reel fordel – ikke som noget, de blot kan acceptere.
