jobs.title: Morgenfrisk medarbejder til vores biludlejning.
jobs.description:
Hos Oscar Biludlejning søger vi en til en medarbejdere til vores afdelinger i Hørsholm og Birkerød, der trives med ansvar, kan arbejde selvstændigt og sætter en ære i, at tingene er i orden.

Du bliver den person, der sørger for, at vores biler står klar til kunderne – rene, velholdte og klar til afhentning fra morgenstunden. Vores kunder forventer en god oplevelse, og den starter med en bil, der lever op til en høj standard.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Tjekke biler ind og ud

  • Registrere eventuelle skader, kilometerstand og brændstofniveau

  • Kontrollere bilernes generelle stand og være opmærksom på rengøring og eventuel røglugt

  • Rengøre og tanke bilerne efter behov

  • Klargøre bilerne til næste udlejning

  • Håndtere nøgler og den digitale nøgleboks

  • Holde øje med dæk, olie og øvrige væsker

  • Hjælpe med at få biler til og fra værksted, når der er behov for det

Hos Oscar Biludlejning udlejer vi primært brugte biler, men derfor skal standarden stadig være høj. Vi forventer, at vores biler er præsentable, driftssikre og klar til brug – hver eneste dag.

Et job med frihed og ansvar:

Du får ansvaret for den daglige drift i både Birkerød og Hørsolm, og planlægger i høj grad selv dit arbejde. Stillingen er på cirka 2–3 timer om dagen, mandag til fredag. Nogle dage tager det lidt kortere tid, andre dage lidt længere.

Arbejdet ligger primært om morgenen, og du skal være indstillet på at starte tidligt, så bilerne er klar til kunderne omkring kl. 08.00. Til gengæld har du tidligt fri.

En del af opgaverne kan følges og planlægges hjemmefra via app og e-mail, og bor du tæt på afdelingen, vil du ofte kunne forberede meget af arbejdet aftenen før.

Derudover vil du hver anden weekend have ansvaret for to afdelinger. Opgaverne vil fortsat ligge om morgenen, og tidsforbruget vil være nogenlunde det samme.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er selvstændig og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Har øje for detaljer og høje kvalitetsstandarder

  • Er praktisk anlagt og kan lide at have orden omkring dig

  • Er fleksibel og hjælpsom over for kolleger

  • Har kørekort til almindelig personbil

  • Ikke er bange for store varevogne (alle biler er max 3.500 kg. til alm. kørekort)

Vi søger først og fremmest en medarbejder, der har lyst til at blive hos os i længere tid. Derfor vægter vi stabilitet og engagement højt.

Stillingen kan være særligt interessant for dig, der er førtidspensionist, efterlønner eller pensionist, og som ønsker et fleksibelt deltidsjob med faste rutiner, ansvar og kontakt til mennesker.

Du vil naturligvis få grundig oplæring, så du føler dig tryg i opgaverne og godt klædt på til rollen.

Kunne det være noget for dig?

Så send os en ansøgning og fortæl lidt om dig selv og din motivation for at blive en del af Oscar Biludlejning.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette person.

jobs.title: Partner Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

About the Role

Signing a capture partner is the start of the work. Getting that partner to steady, high-quality output takes onboarding, training, hardware, support, and reporting, and every step has to run on time.

As Partnership Operations Manager, you will own that path for our regional partnership leads so they can focus on finding and signing partners. This is a new function, so you will set the standards and tooling yourself and make them repeatable across regions.

What You Will Do

  • Deal support: Prepare proposals and agreements from approved templates and keep a clean record of every partnerâs rates, volumes, and term dates.

  • Onboarding: Set partners up on the platform, issue devices and accounts, and train their teams on capture standards so they reach full output quickly.

  • Hardware: Manage device allocation, tracking, replacements, and returns with our hardware and logistics teams, and keep inventory records accurate.

  • Partner support: Be the first point of contact for partners, and run the support channel to clear service levels. Resolve problems yourself or route them to product, engineering, or finance before capture is disrupted, and pass on what partners need from the platform and devices.

  • Performance and reporting: Monitor daily performance and quality across partners, including recorded, approved, and deliverable hours, recording counts, and QA rejection rates. Act when numbers slip, and raise anything commercial with the partnerâs regional lead. Keep scorecards, business reviews, and the data behind them current.

  • Payments: Own partner payments and reconciliation, making sure hours are approved correctly and paid accurately and on time.

  • Playbook: Build and improve the processes, checklists, and tools that keep partner operations running as the network grows.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 3 to 5+ years in partner or vendor operations, supply or merchant onboarding, business operations, program or project management, or account management, ideally at a high-growth marketplace, delivery, or BPO company.

  • Execution: A record of running many partner launches at once across time zones, with clear process and tight follow-up.

  • Organization: Highly organized and detail-focused, able to manage many partners and tasks at once without letting things slip.

  • AI fluency: You use AI tools in your day-to-day work to pull and analyze data, draft partner communications, and streamline your own processes.

  • Problem solving: A practical problem-solver who stays calm under pressure and sees problems through to resolution.

  • Relationships: Strong interpersonal skills. You work well with both partners and internal teams.

  • Agency: A high degree of initiative and comfort with ambiguity. This is an early and unstructured role, so you will set your own priorities, work without an established playbook, and build processes where none yet exists.

Even better if you have

  • Industry: Background in data collection, AI training data, or BPO services.

  • Field deployment: Experience with device deployment and inventory tracking across partner sites.

  • Multi-country: Experience running partner operations across several countries and time zones.

  • Languages: Working fluency in one or more of our regionsâ main business languages, alongside professional English.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply â we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs.

We may use AI-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered.

jobs.title: Scientific Account Executive
jobs.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

Weâre growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the role

This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers â from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs.

The day-to-day:

  • Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing

  • Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform

  • Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results

  • Working with the biology team to troubleshoot when a customer's experiment doesn't go as expected

  • Identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts â new targets, new assay types, larger campaigns

You won't be handed a script. You'll need to understand the science well enough to earn trust from PhD-level protein engineers and CSOs, while also being commercially sharp enough to close deals and grow accounts.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full customer lifecycle: prospecting, technical sales conversations, deal closing, onboarding, and ongoing account management.

  • Serve as the technical point of contact for customers. Understand their protein engineering goals and recommend the right experiments (binding, expression, thermostability, enzyme activity).

  • Understand and explain our assay capabilities in depth: BLI, SPR, cell-free expression, and emerging assay types. Know when each is appropriate and what the data means.

  • Work closely with the biology team to ensure experiments are designed correctly and results are communicated clearly.

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of commercial opportunities across customer segments: AI-driven protein design companies, biotech startups, pharma R&D teams, and academic labs.

  • Develop proposals and quotes tailored to customer needs, from small pilot experiments to large-scale data generation campaigns.

  • Represent Adaptyv at conferences and industry events. Be able to have deep technical conversations at the booth, not just hand out brochures.

  • Feed customer insights back to the product and biology teams: what assays are people asking for, what's missing, where are we losing deals.

What we're looking for

  • Scientific background in protein engineering, biochemistry, biophysics, or a related field. You should be comfortable discussing binding kinetics (KD, kon, koff), expression systems, and assay design without needing to look things up.

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role: field application scientist, technical sales, scientific account management, or similar. CRO or biotech vendor experience is a strong plus.

  • Commercially driven. You care about revenue, pipeline, and closing deals, not just having interesting scientific conversations.

  • Strong communicator who can adapt to the audience: detailed and technical with a scientist, concise and business-focused with a VP.

  • Self-starter who can manage their own pipeline and priorities without heavy oversight.

  • Genuine interest in AI-driven protein design and the companies working in this space. You follow what's happening in the field.

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

conditions.At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. jobs.title: Executive Operations Partner - EPD (Executive Assistant)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Our Executive Operations team work closely with Notion’s leadership, serving as trusted advisors, collaborators, and problem-solvers. We focus on amplifying the impact of our executives by anticipating needs, streamlining operations, and building systems that keep leaders focused on the highest leverage work. We’re deeply connected to Notion’s mission and values, and we take pride in creating an environment of collaboration, clarity, and authenticity. Our team thrives on strong relationships, operational excellence, and a shared commitment to building tools that empower people to think and work together more effectively.

This role calls for someone who is proactive, adaptable, and deeply organized. Someone who can balance complex scheduling, drive cross-functional coordination, and bring clarity to fast moving priorities. This person will support 2 leaders in our Engineering and Product orgs. Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, operates independently, and consistently finds ways to improve workflows and communication. You’ll be a key partner in making sure our leaders and the company as a whole can move quickly while staying aligned. 

 

This role is based in our San Francisco office. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Organizational support: Partner with Engineering and Product leaders on running the day-to-day of an efficient, high-velocity, and fun organization

 - Calendar management: Prioritize and coordinate the teams’ operating calendar, ensuring time is spent in a way that's most leveraged to achieve our business objectives

 - Meeting aficionado: Organize, attend, and track meeting notes and action items, with an eye on making every interaction productive and warm

 - Travel planner: Flights, hotels, transportation, dining, etc. A strong attention to detail here is valued

 - Expense management: Manages expense reports for the executives you support

 - Culture carrier and community builder: Craft fun & engaging team offsite experiences, celebrate birthdays and anniversaries, new family members, and promotions to ensure employees continue to feel connected and recognized




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of Executive Operations experience at fast-growing companies, ideally with experience with technical teams.

 - Organized and detail-oriented: Strong attention to detail, able to stay calm under pressure, a quick thinker, create order of out chaos

 - Effective communicator: Ability to communicate the priorities of leadership within Notion, whether it is by written, verbal, or group communication

 - Event planning: Experience organizing team events with hundreds of people, as well as multi-day events with smaller groups of people, such as an executive offsite

 - EQ: Love connecting with employees, and have proven ability to build relationships and bring warmth to all levels of the organization

 - Discreet: Demonstrated ability to maintain complete confidentiality on all business matters




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're a Notion evangelist! You love the product, and already use it in your daily life



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $190,000.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

3D-skannaaja rakennuskohteisiin
jobs.description: **Kiinnostaako sinua 3D-teknologia, digitaalinen aineisto ja käytännön työ erilaisissa kohteissa? Tule mukaan muuttamaan olemassa olevia rakennuksia tarkaksi 3D-aineistoksi. Aikaisempaa kokemusta 3D-skannauksesta tai rakennusalalta ei tarvita. Ratkaisevaa on tekninen uteliaisuus, huolellinen työote ja halu oppia.**_Me Parmacolla uskomme, että rakennusten tulisi olla yhtä joustavia kuin yhteisöt, joita ne palvelevat. Muutamme yhteiskuntaa dynaamisella arkkitehtuurilla – muunneltavilla, siirrettävillä ja kiertotalouteen perustuvilla rakennuksilla, jotka elävät käyttäjiensä mukana. Tule mukaan tekemään tilaa kestävälle tulevaisuudelle!_Haemme noin **yhdeksää 3D-skannaajaa** määräaikaiseen projektiin 31.12.2026 saakka. Jatko on mahdollinen projektin ja Parmacon työtilanteen mukaan. Saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen sekä kokeneempien asiantuntijoiden ja muun skannaustiimin tuen.**Työ sopii hyvin opintojen rinnalle.** Työaika on 0–37,5 tuntia viikossa, ja tarjotuista työvuoroista voi kieltäytyä. Työvuoroista pyritään sopimaan noin 1–2 viikkoa etukäteen. Tuntipalkka on osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan **15,50–17,00 euroa tunnilta**.Työskentelet osana skannaustiimiä ja kierrät työparisi kanssa Parmacon olemassa olevissa rakennuksissa. Suurin osa kohteista sijaitsee pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta kohdekäyntejä on myös eri puolilla Suomea. Työhön voi kuulua ajoittain yöpymisiä. Käynneistä sovitaan joustavasti opiskelutilanteesi ja käytettävyytesi huomioiden.**Tehtäviisi kuuluu:**- rakennuskohteiden 3D-skannaus työparin kanssa - skannausaineiston jälkikäsittely ja pistepilvien leikkaaminen - skannausten kattavuuden ja laadun tarkistaminen sekä tarvittavat uusintaskannaukset - kohdetietojen, poikkeamien ja vauriohavaintojen huolellinen dokumentointi - skannauslaitteista huolehtiminen sekä projektin käytännön järjestelyihin ja raportointiin osallistuminen. **Menestyt tehtävässä, kun:**- olet kiinnostunut 3D-teknologiasta, digitaalisista työkaluista ja käytännön tekemisestä - opit mielelläsi uusia laitteita ja ohjelmistoja. Sinun ei tarvitse osata niitä valmiiksi. - työskentelet huolellisesti ja järjestelmällisesti sekä huomaat yksityiskohdat - ratkaiset käytännön ongelmia oma-aloitteisesti ja kysyt tarvittaessa apua - viihdyt liikkuvassa työssä ja työskentelet sujuvasti työparin kanssa - sinulla on voimassa oleva B-ajokortti. Omaa autoa ei tarvita. Plussaa, ei edellytys: CAD- tai BIM-ohjelmistot, pistepilvet, 3D-mallinnus tai -skannaus, paikkatieto, data-analyysi, Excel, ohjelmointi, visuaalinen dokumentointi tai muu tekninen tekeminen.**Mitä saat meiltä?**- käytännön kokemusta 3D-skannauksesta ja pistepilviaineistojen käsittelystä - perehdytyksen työssä käytettäviin laitteisiin, ohjelmistoihin ja toimintatapoihin - mahdollisuuden yhdistää liikkuvaa kenttätyötä ja digitaalisen aineiston käsittelyä - kokeneempien asiantuntijoiden ja skannaustiimin tuen - mahdollisuuden kehittää skannausprosessia yhdessä Parmacon asiantuntijoiden kanssa **Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi.** Kannustamme erilaisista taustoista tulevia osaajia hakemaan. Arvioimme hakijat tehtävän kannalta olennaisen osaamisen, valmiuksien ja motivaation perusteella.

Tuntipalkka on osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan **17,00–19,00 euroa tunnilta.**Työskentelet osana skannaustiimiä sekä rakennuskohteissa että skannausaineistojen teknisen käsittelyn ja kehittämisen parissa. Suurin osa kohteista sijaitsee pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta kohdekäyntejä on myös eri puolilla Suomea. Käynneistä sovitaan joustavasti opiskelutilanteesi ja käytettävyytesi huomioiden.**Tehtäviisi kuuluu:**- rakennuskohteiden 3D-skannaus yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa - skannausaineistojen käsittely valmiin prosessin mukaisesti, pistepilvien jälkikäsittely ja käsittelyprosessin kehittäminen edelleen - Power Apps -käyttöliittymän rakentaminen skannausaineistojen tarkistamista varten - skannausaineistojen, käsittelyprosessin ja kuvantunnistusratkaisujen testaaminen, laadun varmistaminen ja kehittäminen - aineistojen nimeämisestä, versiohallinnasta ja järjestelmällisestä arkistoinnista huolehtiminen - muun skannaustiimin tekninen tukeminen sekä teknisen dokumentaation ja perehdytyksen kehittäminen. Lisäksi tuot projektista havaintoja ja tietoa Parmacon tekoälyratkaisujen ja portfoliohallinnan tietokannan kehittämisen tueksi. **Tehtävä ei edellytä varsinaista ohjelmointiosaamista.****Menestyt tehtävässä, kun:**- sinulla on opintojen, työkokemuksen tai muun kokemuksen kautta hyvä ymmärrys rakennussuunnittelusta sekä rakennuksista ja rakenteista - olet kiinnostunut tietotekniikasta ja opit nopeasti uusia ohjelmistoja ja digitaalisia työkaluja - työskentelet huolellisesti ja järjestelmällisesti, huomaat yksityiskohdat ja osaat erottaa havainnot oletuksista - tartut uusiin tilanteisiin oma-aloitteisesti, etsit ratkaisuja myös silloin, kun valmista vastausta ei ole, ja viet asiat sinnikkäästi eteenpäin - pystyt viemään kehitysideoita käytäntöön ja työskentelet sujuvasti muun tiimin kanssa - sinulla on voimassa oleva B-ajokortti. Omaa autoa ei tarvita Rakennusalan korkeakouluopinnot ovat tehtävään hyvä pohja. Tehtävä sopii erityisesti rakennustekniikan, rakennussuunnittelun tai arkkitehtuurin opinnoissa pidemmälle edenneelle opiskelijalle. Kannustamme erilaisista taustoista tulevia osaajia hakemaan. Arvioimme hakijat tehtävän kannalta olennaisen osaamisen, valmiuksien ja motivaation perusteella.

jobs.title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization.

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

jobs.title: Marketing Koordinator til MyCruise (barselsvikariat)
jobs.description:
Er du struktureret, initiativrig og god til at holde mange bolde i luften? 

Brænder du for marketing, og trives du med at skabe overblik, koordinere kampagner og få mennesker til at arbejde godt sammen? 

Hos MyCruise søger vi en Marketing Koordinator til vores marketingteam på hovedkontoret i Vanløse. 

Stillingen er et 9-måneders barselsvikariat med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. 

Som Marketing Koordinator får du en central rolle i at koordinere vores marketingaktiviteter på tværs af Danmark, Norge, Sverige og UK. 

Du bliver bindeleddet mellem vores kampagneansvarlige, lokale salgsteams og specialister inden for blandt andet paid media, sociale medier, nyhedsbreve, grafisk produktion og e-commerce. 

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at skabe struktur, sikre fremdrift og sørge for, at vores kampagner og marketingaktiviteter bliver gennemført til tiden og i høj kvalitet. 

Du bliver en del af et marketingteam med mange forskellige opgaver, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, hjælper hinanden og har plads til både gode idéer og godt humør. 

Om jobbet 

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du er med til at sikre, at vores marketingkampagner hænger sammen på tværs af kanaler og markeder. 

Du kommer blandt andet til at: 

  • Koordinere marketingkampagner på tværs af teams, kanaler og samarbejdspartnere. 

  • Omsætte kampagnebriefs til konkrete opgaver og holde styr på deadlines, materialer og leverancer. 

  • Sikre tæt dialog mellem marketing og de lokale salgsteams om behov og kampagner. 

  • Koordinere versionering, oversættelser og lokal tilpasning af nyhedsbreve og øvrigt marketingmateriale. 

  • Assistere med tekstforfatning, korrektur, nyhedsbreve og lettere indholdsopgaver. 

  • Koordinere indhold og materialer til websites, sociale medier og annoncering. 

  • Hjælpe med dokumentation og afrapportering af partnerkampagner. 

  • Indsamle kampagneresultater og bidrage til evaluering og forbedring af kommende aktiviteter. 

  • Bidrage med idéer og praktisk hjælp til øvrige marketingaktiviteter efter behov. 

Du får selvstændigt ansvar for den daglige koordinering, men arbejder tæt sammen med vores kampagneansvarlige om prioriteringer, budgetter og timing. 

Du skal ikke kunne producere alt selv. Det vigtigste er, at du kan skabe overblik, følge op og sikre, at de rette mennesker har, hvad de skal bruge for at komme i mål. 

 

Vi forestiller os, at du: 

  • Har en god forståelse for marketing, er naturligt struktureret og trives med en hverdag, hvor der sker mange ting.  

  • Gerne har 2-3 års erfaring fra en koordinatorrolle i en marketingafdeling, et digitalt bureau, reklamebureau eller lignende. 

  • Har en relevant uddannelse inden for marketing, kommunikation eller tilsvarende. 

  • Har en god forståelse for digital marketing, herunder sociale medier, nyhedsbreve, annoncering og websites. 

  • Har erfaring med eller kendskab til projektstyringsværktøjer som Asana, Monday.com eller lignende. 

  • Har gode skriftlige kommunikationsevner og flair for kommercielt indhold. 

  • Er struktureret, detaljeorienteret og god til at følge op på opgaver og deadlines. 

  • Er proaktiv, har ben i næsen og tør stille spørgsmål og udfordre kolleger konstruktivt. 

  • Bevarer overblikket, også når tempoet er højt, og flere opgaver skal løses samtidig. 

Har du erfaring fra rejsebranchen, arbejdet med marketing på tværs af flere lande eller kendskab til Klaviyo, CMS eller Canva, er det en fordel - men ikke et krav. 

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tager initiativ og motiveres af at skabe struktur og gode resultater sammen med andre. 

Hvem er MyCruise? 

MyCruise er et af Skandinaviens førende specialiserede krydstogtsrejsebureauer. Vi samarbejder med en lang række af verdens største krydstogtsrederier og hjælper hvert år vores kunder med at finde den helt rigtige rejse. 

Vi sælger både klassiske ocean cruises, Exclusive cruises og River cruises. 

Vi har kontorer i Danmark, Norge, Sverige og Storbritannien, mens vores danske hovedkontor ligger i Vanløse. Her arbejder marketing tæt sammen med blandt andet salg, produkt og e-commerce om at inspirere vores kunder og skabe gode rejseoplevelser. 

Vi er i vækst og har store ambitioner for de kommende år. Derfor leder vi efter mennesker, der har lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os. 

Hvad tilbyder vi? 

  • En spændende og alsidig marketingrolle med mulighed for at gøre en forskel. 

  • Tæt samarbejde med engagerede kolleger på tværs af vores fire markeder. 

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling. 

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med marketing i en branche, hvor vi sælger oplevelser og rejser. 

  • Personalepriser på rejser. 

  • Pension og sundhedsordning. 

  • Frokostordning, frugt, kaffe og sodavand. 

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger. 

  • En organisation med korte beslutningsveje og plads til nye idéer. 

  • Arbejdsplads på vores hovedkontor i Vanløse tæt på metro og S-tog. 

Lyder det som dig? 

Send dit CV og din ansøgning til job@mycruise.dk 

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. 

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat på 9 måneder med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. Vi ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt, og arbejdsstedet er vores hovedkontor i Vanløse.

jobs.title: Senior Assigned Support Engineer-(Designated / Premier Support)
Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Join Beneq as an Electrical Engineer – Shape the Future of ALD Research Tools!Many breakthroughs in materials science, energy and microelectronics begin in a research lab, on an Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) tool. Those tools have to be flexible, safe and electrically reliable. At Beneq, we build them.Were looking for an Electrical Engineer to join the TFS product team in our Advanced ALD Business Unit. Youll design the electrical systems behind our TFS ALD equipment, which is used by universities, research institutes and corporate R&D labs around the world. This is a hands-on engineering role. Youll take designs from schematics and customer-specific modifications all the way to certified, fully documented deliveries, working closely with mechanical and automation engineers along the way.As a global leader in ALD solutions, Beneq offers the opportunity to work on technology that enables the next generation of thin film innovation. Many of our deliveries include customer-specific configurations, so youll regularly solve new design challenges. Youll also see the direct impact of your work on equipment used at the forefront of science.If youre an Electrical Engineer who enjoys variety, thrives in cross-disciplinary collaboration and is always looking for ways to make things work better, wed love to hear from you.Your Key Responsibilities * Design, develop and maintain electrical structures, schematics and related documents for Beneqs TFS ALD equipment. * Prepare product purchase structures for customer deliveries and design customer-specific modifications. * Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards (CE, UL) and related requirements. * Support certification processes and maintain the technical documentation needed for regulatory compliance. * Work with software/automation and mechanical engineers to ensure seamless system integration. * Support internal teams on electrical performance questions, both in TFS and across other Advanced ALD product teams. * Identify opportunities for efficiency improvements and new technology adoption, and contribute to new product development.What Were Looking For * 3+ years in electrical system design, including low-voltage and high-power systems. Close-but-not-exact experience is worth a conversation. * A Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. * Proficiency in EPLAN and AutoCAD or a similar electrical design tool. * Working knowledge of electrical safety and CE, UL, EMI/EMC and IEC certification requirements. * Familiarity with PLC systems, especially Siemens S7. * Understanding of functional safety systems in relation to electrical design. * A detail-oriented, quality-focused approach, plus strong problem-solving, collaboration and communication skills.Bonus Skills That Set You Apart * Qualification for conducting electrical installations. * Experience in thin film processing equipment (ALD, PVD, CVD or PECVD). * Knowledge of ERP and PDM systems such as SAP and Aton.Why Join Beneq?Youll work with one of the worlds top ALD teams at the forefront of thin film innovation. Our environment is collaborative and supportive, and the hierarchy is flat enough that your work is visible. We offer a competitive salary, strong work-life balance, and opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning in a high-tech, international company.How to ApplyAre you ready to take the next step in your career? Submit your application and CV by 19.11. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we may start the interview process during the application period.For more information, feel free to contact Jan-Erik Kari, Engineering Manager 0407618584, Fridays 6th and 13th 10.00-11.00.Beneq is the home of atomic layer deposition. Our mission is to be dedicated to the success of the More-than-Moore device makers by delivering best in class, innovative, and flexible ALD equipment and service solutions. In 1984, we established the worlds first industrial production using ALD. Today, we lead the market with products for semiconductor device fabrication, R&D, and varied ALD solutions. We operate globally and employ 170+ people on three continents. We are a unique employer that combines the hands-on, dynamic mindset of a fast-growth startup with the solid funding and resources of a larger enterprise. Beneqs team of engineers and experts are committed to delivering world class ALD solutions and enabling technology mega trends through advanced solutions. Beneq is headquartered in Finland with legal entities in the USA and Japan.

jobs.title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing Department of Food Science Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative. The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:
  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:
  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties. The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered. Associate professor Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required. The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. Applicants must be capable of, and interested in, conducting and developing basic and applied interdisciplinary research of high international standard in the field of food processing and technology. The position will involve extensive collaborations within the department and with national and international academic groups and industrial partners. Research within the Department has a mission to unearth new solutions for society and industry to support sustainable food production, food security and safety as well as production of high-quality food promoting human health and wellbeing. The Department of Food Science is recognized for excellence in food research, education, and industrial collaborations. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. We encourage applications from a range of disciplines within the food science and technology area, ideally covering the understanding of food macromolecular interactions on a mechanistic level, how processing and formulation affect or determine these interactions, and how this influences final product quality with focus on functional properties. We are seeking a candidate who will establish an internationally leading research program, and we encourage a diverse range of applicants whose work may center on one or more of the following disciplines:
  • Developing a mechanistic understanding of interactions of food macromolecules in complex matrices during processing or formulation spanning dairy, plant, and single-cell protein sources.
  • How this knowledge can be used in the rational design of functional ingredients and healthy foods using established and emerging processing technologies
  • Development and utilization of high throughput methods for characterizing and quantifying the physicochemical behavior of food macromolecules in complex matrices.
  • Modelling and the use of machine learning/AI for simulation and prediction of the outcome of process unit operations on food and ingredient functionality.
  • Formulation and fluid dynamics of complex emulsions and the mechanisms governing this.
In addition, it is expected that this position will be involved in a significant amount of collaboration with industry, and therefore it is expected that the successful candidate has a documented successful track record in industry collaboration and working with innovation-oriented research. Furthermore, we expect that the successful candidate has a genuine interest in leadership and the wellbeing and development of their group. jobs.title: Senior ERP Transformation Lead - IFS Cloud
jobs.description:
Our client is seeking a highly experienced Senior ERP Transformation Lead to lead a large-scale business and ERP modernization initiative for a major Nordic enterprise.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

This is a high-impact leadership assignment with direct exposure to executive stakeholders and responsibility for driving a complex transformation from legacy IFS environments to IFS Cloud. The role goes far beyond traditional project management and requires someone who can effectively lead change, influence senior decisionmakers, and build alignment across both business and technology organizations.

Youll take ownership of a strategic transformation program covering several core business functions, including:
 Finance
 Human Resources
 Procurement & Supplier Management
 Enterprise-wide business processes and supporting platforms

The objective is not only to modernize the ERP landscape, but also to transform business processes, governance models, and ways of working across multiple countries and stakeholder groups.

Key Responsibilities:
 Lead a complex ERP transformation program end-to-end
 Drive migration from legacy IFS to IFS Cloud
 Act as the bridge between business and technology teams
 Engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-level executives
 Establish governance, alignment, and decision-making across the organization
 Lead change management and business transformation activities

Requirements:
 Proven experience leading large-scale ERP transformation programs
Strong IFS / IFS Cloud transformation experience
 Background in business transformation and organizational change
 Experience working directly with executive stakeholders
 Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
 Experience in multinational and complex business environments

Ideal Profile:
You are a senior transformation leader who combines ERP expertise with strong executive presence and the ability to build alignment, challenge stakeholders, and drive change across business and IT functions.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Have you led an ERP transformation involving IFS or IFS Cloud?*
- Have you worked directly with CIO, CFO, or other C-level stakeholders?*
- Have you led business transformation alongside technology implementation?*
- Have you managed stakeholders across multiple countries or business units?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. 

Start: ASAP
Location: Finland
Allocation: Full-time 100 %
Duration: 14-18 months initially, with potential extension
Languages: English required, Finnish preferred

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi 

Explore Lokki, through our blog and website: https://www.lokki.fi/  .

Lokki Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy (Finnish for Seagull Recruitment Services) has been active in providing recruitment services since 2005 and we belong to The Private Employment Agencies Association HPL. Our vision is to provide the best customer experience with our reliable, humane and effortless service around Finland. Our most important asset is a person who, as we know, thrives in a reliable and supportive atmosphere. At Loki you will be supported by your own human resources consultant throughout your employment relationship. At Lokki, we believe in a partnership achieved as a result of flexible service. Explore us and our vacancies: https://www.lokki.fi/.

You can also find us on Facebook and Instagram.

jobs.title: Administrativ kontorelev med interesse for drift og kørselsdisponering
jobs.description:
Bliv godt kørende med en elevuddannelse hos HB-Care! Som kontorelev hos HB-Care bliver du en vigtig del af det daglige arbejde i vores driftsteam, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at levere kvalitet og god kundeservice. Du får en 2-årig elevuddannelse med speciale i administration, hvor du både kommer på skoleforløb og får masser af praktisk erfaring i virksomheden.

Undervejs bliver du introduceret til alle relevante områder, og du får også mulighed for at besøge vores andre afdelinger som fx bogholderi og udbud.

Vi tilbyder en alsidig uddannelse med praktisk erfaring, som giver dig et bredt kendskab til vores forskellige opgaver inden for driftsoptimering og administration.

Dine arbejdsopgaverHverdagen i vores driftsteam er præget af højt tempo. Vores vigtigste opgave er at supportere vores kunder – både borgere og institutioner – via mail og telefon.

Som elev vil du bl.a. arbejde med:

  • Indtastning og vedligeholdelse af stamdata
  • Oprettelse i kundesystemer
  • Administrative opgaver, der understøtter effektiv kørsel
  • Daglig support til drift og disponering
  • Håndtering af uforudsete hændelser i løbet af arbejdsdagen

Du får en spændende rolle, hvor du deltager aktivt i den daglige drift og gradvist får mere ansvar. Du refererer til regionschefen for Sjælland og Fyn.

Hvem er du?Vi søger dig, som har:

  • En naturlig interesse for processer
  • En struktureret og selvstændig tilgang til opgaver
  • Gode IT-kompetencer, især i Office-pakken
  • Øje for detaljer og lyst til at levere grundige resultater
  • Evne til at håndtere en varieret hverdag, hvor du kan blive afbrudt midt i en opgave
  • Gode samarbejdsevner og lyst til at hjælpe både kunder og kolleger

Uddannelseskrav:Du har bestået – eller forventer at bestå – en af følgende:

  • EUX Business (kontor)
  • HHX
  • HF, HTX eller STX samt 5 ugers EUS-forløb 

Er du over 25 år?Så skal du kontakte din lokale handelsskole for at få lavet en realkompetencevurdering (RKV), som skal vedhæftes din ansøgning.

OBS: Husk, at du ikke må oplyse dit CPR-nummer i din ansøgning eller dit CV.

Ansættelsesdato:Ønsket opstart mellem d. 1. januar og 1. marts 2027 – men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat. Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Hvem er vi?HB-Care er Danmarks førende leverandør af visiteret specialkørsel til kommuner og institutioner. Vi sørger hver dag for, at ældre borgere kommer til genoptræning, at skolebørn bliver kørt til undervisning, og at personer med særlige behov kommer sikkert frem til deres destinationer. Vores arbejde kræver både præcision, struktur og stor omtanke – og det er netop her, du kan blive en vigtig del af vores team.

jobs.title: Vastuumyyjä, Sale Lauste, Turku, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description: Primary location:TURKUSale Lauste etsii tiimiinsä vastuumyyjää!Tehtävä on osa-aikainen 30h/vko ja määräaikainen 31.12.2027 asti. Työt olisi tarkoitus aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.Vastuumyyjänä varmistat kaupan arjen sujuvuuden ja asiakastyytyväisyyden yhdessä myymäläpäällikön ja apulaispäällikön kanssa. Työpäivät koostuvat ihan perus tehtävistä, kuten asiakaspalvelusta, kassa- ja hyllytystyöstä, robotilauksien keräilystä sekä myymälän yleisestä järjestelystä ja siivouksesta. Lisäksi huolehdit tuoteryhmien saatavuudesta, tuotteiden tuoreudesta ja osaston siisteydestä. Hyödynnät tehtävässäsi raportteja ja järjestelmiä muun muassa tilauksiin sekä saldojen ja hävikin hallintaan.Toimit arjen esimerkkinä muulle tiimille kaikissa kaupan työtehtävissä, ja varmistat työvuorolle asetettujen tavoitteiden toteutumisen sekä priorisoit ja organisoit työtehtäviä. Huolehdit osaltasi sujuvasta tiedonkulusta. Lisäksi perehdytät uusia työntekijöitä, jaat osaamistasi sekä autat tiimiä onnistumaan päivittäisessä työssä.Työaika sijoittuu arkisin ja viikonloppuisin klo 6.30–21.10 välille.Varmistathan, että sinulla on mahdollisuus kulkea toimipaikkaan kaikkina kaupan aukioloaikoina.Millaista tyyppiä etsimme?Vastuumyyjänä onnistut tehtävässä, jos olet asiakaslähtöinen, helposti lähestyttävä ja toimeen tarttuva. Haluat olla luomassa onnistuneita asiakaskokemuksia ja toimit jokaisessa asiakaskohtaamisessa esimerkkinä muulle tiimille. Sinulla on positiivinen työskentelyote sekä hyvät viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaidot. Pystyt ohjaamaan tiimin toimintaa, johtamaan työvuoroa sekä antamaan palautetta. Lisäksi sinulle sopii fyysinen vuorotyö, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevissa vuoroissa ja työtehtävissä, sekä kohtaat satoja ihmisiä päivässä. Vastuumyyjältä edellytämme aikaisempaa työkokemusta myyjän tehtävistä, ja eduksi katsomme kokemuksen vastuutehtävistä.Vastuumyyjän palkka perustuu Kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen palkkaluokkaan B sekä tehtäväkohtaiseen vaativamman työn lisään. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 11,33-15,15 €/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.Liity meidän porukkaan, niin tarjoamme sinulle:Ihan tavallisia töitä, epätavallisen hyvillä henkilöstöeduilla! Työskennellessäsi meillä, saat rahanarvoisia ostoetuja S-etukortillasi, kuten S-ryhmän ravintoloista –25 %,Sokos ja Emotion myymälöistä -15 % tai autopesusta –50 %Työpäiviä poikkeuksellisen rennossa porukassa yhdessä Suomen innostavimmassa työpaikassaKattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävääsi ja mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun, jota tukevat S-ryhmän monipuoliset oppimis- ja valmennusmahdollisuudetJos ihan tavalliset työt houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan 8.11. mennessä! Me ollaan sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse 010 764 –alkuisesta numerosta. Kannattaa seurata myös roskapostia, sillä meidän viestit voivat eksyä myös sinne.Haluaisitko kuulla lisää tehtävästä ja Turun Osuuskaupasta? &#x1f4de; Lisätietoja antaamyymäläpäällikkö JuliusAlikirri. Juliuksen tavoitat parhaiten arkisin klo 9–15 numerosta 010 764 3281.Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi täällä tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. Meitä tokkilaisia on reilu 2600 ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. Työskentelemme pilke silmäkulmassa ja tavoitteenamme on olla asiakkaiden ykkösvalinta! Lue lisää Turun Osuuskaupasta: Tietoa meistä – TOK.

jobs.title: Elektronik fremstilling og test
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at fremstille avanceret måleudstyr, der anvendes til måling af vakuumtryk i højteknologiske produktionsprocesser?

Vi søger en engageret og detalje orienteret produktionsmedarbejder med erfaring inden for elektronikmontage, og som trives i et mindre team, hvor kvalitet og samarbejde er i fokus.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. være:

  • Montage af elektroniske og mekaniske komponenter

  • Loddearbejde (både SMT og through-hole)

  • Test og kalibrering af transducere

  • Kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation

Hos Sens4 bliver du en del af et mindre team, der samler, tester og konfigurerer tryk- og vakuumtransducere. Derudover vil du også indgå i opgaver omkring kvalitetskontrol ved varemodtagelse.

  • Har erfaring med lodning og arbejde med små komponenter

  • Arbejder struktureret og tager ansvar for kvaliteten af dit arbejde

  • Er en teamplayer, der trives i en mindre virksomhed med stor fleksibilitet

Vi tilbyder:

  • En alsidig hverdag med varierende opgaver, hvor vi hjælper hinanden

  • Et godt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø med en flad struktur og korte beslutningsveje

jobs.title: Vi søger rengøringshelte på 35 timer til Børnehave Solsikken med ansættelse pr. 1. januar 2027
jobs.description:
Bliv en del af Team Rent Guld – vi hjemtager rengøringen i hele kommunen Team Rent Guld er Guldborgsund Kommunes samlede rengøringsenhed, som fra 1. januar 2027 får ansvaret for rengøringen på tværs af hele kommunen. Vi er i gang med at opbygge en professionel og velfungerende organisation, hvor kvalitet, stabil drift og godt samarbejde er i centrum.

Vi leder efter engagerede rengøringshelte, som vil være med til at skabe rene, sunde og indbydende rammer for kommunens borgere og medarbejdere. Den gyldne mission er at indeklimaet er en ren fornøjelse at befinde sig i.

Om Team Rent Guld Afdelingen bliver en stor og vigtig del af kommunens daglige drift og vil bestå af 2 afdelingsledere, 3 fagkoordinatorer, 3 flyvere og ca. 90 rengøringsassistenter. Sammen sikrer vi rene, sunde og indbydende rammer for både borgere, brugere og medarbejdere.

Hos os er rengøring en faglig opgave, der gør en reel forskel. Vi arbejder systematisk med kvalitet, moderne metoder og gode arbejdsgange – og vi prioriterer, at alle medarbejdere er godt klædt på til opgaven.

Samtidig lægger vi stor vægt på fællesskab og fleksibilitet. Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af lokationer ved fravær, spidsbelastninger og hovedrengøring, og vi tror på, at en god arbejdsdag skabes gennem samarbejde, ansvar og en positiv tilgang.

Team Rent Guld er derfor ikke bare en arbejdsplads – det er et fællesskab, hvor du bliver en del af noget større og er med til at sætte standarden for fremtidens kommunale rengøring.

jobs.title: Executive Director, People & Organisation
jobs.description:
Would you like to shape the people, culture and organisational foundations of one of the world’s leading humanitarian organisations?  

This is an opportunity to bring your global leadership experience to a mission with profound human impact. As Executive Director for People & Organisation (P&O) at the Danish Refugee Council (DRC), you will inspire employees, empower leaders and turn strategy into meaningful change – ensuring that DRC has the people, capabilities, structures and safeguards required to deliver effective humanitarian responses wherever they are needed most.  

You will join DRC at an important time and have a real opportunity to influence its global direction and organisation. The global humanitarian system is going through fundamental change, and you will help shape and adapt organisational structure, operating models and staff capacity to the challenges and opportunities of the future. Your portfolio is global and spans organisation and culture, HR and leadership development, surge capacity, safety, legal affairs and Code of Conduct. As a member of the Executive Management Team, you will help shape strategy, and you will lead approximately 200 colleagues across P&O functions in headquarters and countries. About the job 

Reporting directly to the Secretary General, you will set the direction for DRC’s global People & Organisation strategy and ensure that it becomes an enabler for DRC’s ambitions. In close partnership with the Executive Management Team and senior leaders, you will create the conditions for talented people to grow and thrive – while strengthening an inclusive, and high-performing culture. 

This role calls for a leader who enjoys moving between strategic ambition and practical delivery. You will ensure that global policies, systems, data, employment conditions and governance provide relevant and timely support to operations. At the same time, you will carry executive accountability for safeguarding, ethical conduct, legal compliance, safety and DRC’s humanitarian surge capacity – areas fundamental to DRC’s mission. 

You will lead and develop an experienced senior team; Global HR, HR Denmark, HR Operations & Analytics, Surge Capacity, Safety, Code of Conduct, Legal, management support, and change, leadership and culture. Based at DRC’s headquarters in Copenhagen, you will work across a global organisation and build trusted relationships with colleagues and partners from many cultures and contexts. 

The impact you will make: 

  • Shape DRC’s strategy, culture and global P&O agenda. 

  • Lead organisational change, leadership development and employee engagement. 

  • Attract, develop and retain the people DRC needs to deliver its mission. 

  • Ensure effective global P&O policies, systems, services and people insights. 

  • Oversee safeguarding, Code of Conduct, safety, legal compliance, duty of care. 

  • Strengthen humanitarian surge capacity. 

About you 

You are a credible executive who is motivated by purpose and energised by complexity. You bring the strategic perspective to see the whole organisation, the judgement to make thoughtful choices and the drive to translate ambition into clear priorities and measurable results. Colleagues experience you as an inclusive and trusted leader with integrity and empathy providing the clarity to make decisions and create momentum.  

What you will bring: 

  • 10+ years of senior experience in global organisations and people leadership. 

  • A strong record of shaping people strategy and leading transformation across complex, international operations. 

  • Experience of organisational development, including the renewal and design of operating models. 

  • Broad understanding of governance, compliance, safeguarding, safety and legal matters.

  • Strong stakeholder management, analytical and communication skills. 

  • An inclusive, decisive and high-integrity leadership style. 

  • A relevant master’s degree and fluent English; additional competency in French, Spanish, Arabic and Danish are an advantage. 

All employees in DRC should master DRC's core competencies: Communicating, Taking the lead, Collaborating, Striving for excellence and Demonstrating integrity. 

We offer 

Contract length: Permanent 

Work location:  Lyngbyvej 100, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, just by Ryparken S-train station. DRC has recently moved to a newly renovated multi-tenant house (VOX) with a modern look and shared green canteen.  

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with the agreement between DRC and Lederaftalen between Dansk Arbejdsgiverforening and Lederne (agreement for managers), which can be found here: www.lederne.dk. This is a national position for which local terms and conditions apply.  

We welcome all nationalities to apply for the role. If you do not have the existing right to work in Denmark, DRC will support with applying and paying for a work permit. 

Application process 

If you are motivated by the opportunity to strengthen a global humanitarian organisation through its people, culture and organisational capabilities, we would welcome your application. Korn Ferry is assisting the Danish Refugee Council with the recruitment of the Executive Director, People & Organisation. Please submit your motivated application and CV through the designated recruitment channel. All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than four pages) in English. Applications sent by email will not be considered. 

Closing date for applications: Wednesday 11th November 2026   

Further information  

For questions regarding the vacancy please contact: Rabea Rehman, Associate | Executive Search at Korn Ferry, E: DRC_PO@KornFerry.com  

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website drc.ngo. 

Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.

Arjen yhteyshenkilö: viestintä asiakkaiden ja työntekijöiden välillä käytännön tilanteissa.Hallinnolliset tehtävät: tarjousten, sopimusten ja laskutuksen taustatietojen ylläpito.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Myyntihenkisyyttä ja halua saavuttaa tavoitteitaJärjestelmällisyyttä ja kykyä hallita useita asioita samanaikaisestiHyviä vuorovaikutus- ja asiakaspalvelutaitojaOma-aloitteisuutta ja ratkaisukeskeistä asennettaSujuvaa suomen ja englannin kieltäVoimassa oleva B-ajokorttiEduksi katsotaan:Kokemus myynnistä, henkilöstövuokrauksesta, viheralalta tai kiinteistöpalveluistaKokemus koordinointi- tai tiiminvetotehtävistäMitä tarjoamme?Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin kasvavassa yrityksessäMahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman työn sisältöön ja yrityksen kehitykseenMutkattoman ja mukavan työyhteisönKokoaikaisen työsuhteen, aloitus sopimuksen mukaanTyön painopiste Helsingissä – toiminta-alueena koko pääkaupunkiseutuNäin haetLähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemus, CV ja palkkatoive osoitteeseen info@toptoimijat.fi.Otsikoi viestisi: "Koordinaattori/myyjä".Haku on auki, kunnes sopiva tekijä löytyy – käsittelemme hakemuksiasaapumisjärjestyksessä, joten toimithan ripeästi.Lisätietoja tehtävästä antavat Petteri Niironen (p. +358 41 507 8687) tai Antti Nurminen (p.+358 50 468 9390).

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow position in Mathematics
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Mathematics, available at the Department of Mathematics, as part of QSTAR – Centre for quantum computing and applications.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.04.2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Department of Mathematics/QSTAR at Blindern, Oslo.

Job description

The position is affiliated with QSTAR - Centre for Quantum Computing and Applications. QSTAR is a five-year research centre funded by the Research Council of Norway (project number 361617) and hosted and led by SINTEF. It brings together researchers at SINTEF, UiO, NTNU, OsloMet and Simula Research Laboratory, with international partners at the University of Copenhagen and RISE in Sweden.

The centre connects four research work packages: fault tolerance and error correction; compilation and Hamiltonian engineering; foundations of quantum algorithms; and quantum algorithms for applications. Together, they address how quantum information can be protected, how algorithms can be implemented, and where quantum computation may offer advantages, particularly in chemistry and optimisation.

PhD candidates become part of a research community spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry and optimisation. The centre’s programme includes seminars, PhD schools, annual retreats and conferences, alongside opportunities for international exchange and collaboration across partner institutions.

Learn more about the centre’s research, people and activities on the QSTAR website

The position is advertised within work package 1 “Fault-tolerance and error correction”. More specifically, the successful candidate will work on theoretical questions in one of the following two projects.

The first project studies questions in the fields of quantum groups and tensor categories, with a particular focus on possible applications to fault-tolerant quantum computation through the paradigm of topological quantum computation. We also aim to develop and extend connections between these fields and quantum information science in a broad sense, beyond fault-tolerance.

The second project is concerned with employing methods of group theory, representation theory and operator algebras to construct new families of quantum codes with improved performance and novel features. Another core task in the second project will be to study various families of quantum channels from the perspective of quantifying noise.

The PhD Fellow will join the Operator Algebra group in Section 6 at the Department of Mathematics, where the work will be conducted in close collaboration with other members of the QSTAR project.

The PhD Fellow will:

  • Look for application of the theory of tensor category and quantum groups to problems related to topological quantum computation.
  • Look for connections between quantum information theory and noncommutative geometry through studying quantum channels as noise models.
  • Work in close collaboration with researchers in operator algebras and quantum information theory.
  • Join a research group with broad expertise in mathematics, quantum chemistry, and theoretical physics.
What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in Mathematics or Physics. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Relevant experience in operator algebras, representation theory, or quantum information theory
  • For applicants with an MSc in Physics, a solid mathematical component in their education is required.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 31.03.2027 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Documented, sound knowledge of one or more of the following topics: C*-algebras, noncommutative geometry, representation theory and its applications to quantum groups, quantum field theory, quantum information theory
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in a Scandinavian language

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest) of maximum length 2 A4 pages.
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records
  • Letters of recommendation: these are not to be submitted with the application, but may be requested later during the evaluation process
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The Department of Mathematics is part of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences at the University of Oslo. The Department is engaged in teaching and research covering a wide spectrum of subjects within mathematics, mechanics and statistics. The research is on theory, methods and applications. The areas represented include: fluid mechanics, biomechanics, statistics and data science, computational mathematics, combinatorics, partial differential equations, stochastics and risk, algebra, geometry, topology, operator algebras, complex analysis and logic. We have almost 50 persons in permanent academic positions and a large number of post docs and Ph.D. students. We also have an administrative and technical staff. The department represents a leading research environment in mathematical areas in Norway, and has a highly international profile.
